III., Nov., 1920; sec. to advising comte. on allowances, in addition, Dec., 1920; asst. adviser, Kelantan, Apr., 1922; sec. to rem., Selangor, Aug., 1926; offr. cls. IV. comnr., lands, S.S., Dec., 1926; cls. IA; under-secr. S.S., 1930; ag. col. sec., S.S., May to June and Aug. to Sept., 1930; pres., mun. comnr., Singapore, Mar., 1931; supernmy. offr., cls. IA, S.S., 1932.

BARTOLO, PROF. SIR AUGUSTO, KT. BACH. (1929), LL.D., B. LIT., F.R.H.S.—B. 1883; matric., Malta Univ., 1901; B.Lit., 1904; called to bar, 1907; edr. for many years of "Daily Malta Chronicle"; prof., hist. of legislation and examr. in law and lit., Malta Univ.; chmn., Malta branch, Empire Parly. Assocn.; Malta Univ. del. at congress of Univ. of Empire in Gt. Britain, 1921; el. for 2nd divn. in leg. assem., Oct., 1921; re-el., June, 1924 and Aug., 1927; min. for educn. and migrn., Aug., 1927; judge, 1934; author of several works on Maltese hist. and Imp. affrs.

BARTON, A. B.V., O.B.E. (1933).—Imp. cust. serv., 1912; cust. ast., Kenya, Sept., 1919; collr. of cust., Apr., 1923; comptr., cust., B. Guiana; collr., gen., Jamaica, 1927; collr., cust. and excise, Trinidad, 1930.

BARTON, C. J. J. T., O.B.E. (1932).—B. 1891; ed. Denstone and Downing Coll., Cambridge; history and law triposea; B.A., 1913; M.A., 1920; asst. dist. comnr., E.A.P., Aug., 1914; ag. dist. comnr., 1917, 1919, 1921; asst. for native affrs., 1923; ag. senr. asst. sec., 1924-26; ag. ast. col. sec., 1927; ag. prin. ast. col. sec. and clk. to exec. coun. on various occasions, 1928-33; senr. ast. col. sec., 1932; ag. dep. col. sec., 1934; author various papers on Kenya tribes and local history.

BARTON, CECIL MOLYNEUX, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1883; ed. Shrewsbury and Trinity Coll., Dublin (hons., classics, law); barrister-at-law, King's Inn, Dublin, 1906; ast. dist. comnr., E.A.P., 1913; rea. mag., 1914-21; ag. judge, sup.
ct., Apr., 1921 to Oct., 1922; legal adviser, Gambia, Dec., 1922; comsnr. to enquire into double inoculation of cattle, 1918; chmn. of coman. to enquire into inoculation of cattle for rinderpest by vety. dept., 1919; ag. judge, sup. ct., on various occasions, 1923-28; mem., exec. and leg. couns.; circuit judge, Gold Coast, 1929; puisne judge, 1934.

BARTON, GEORGE SAMUEL HORACE, B.S.A., D.Sc.A.—B. 1883; ed. Vankleek Hill High Schl., Ontario Agr. Coll., Toronto Univ. (B.S.A.), Laval Univ. (D.Sc.A.); asst., animal husbandry, 1907; lecturer, 1910; prof., 1911; dean, faculty of agr., Macdonald Coll., McGill Univ., 1925; comdr., Agricole Merite, Quebec govt., 1929; dep. min., agr., Canada, 1932.

BARTON, MAJOR P. F., V.D.—Asst. treas., G. Coast, Mar., 1907; addl. col. sec.'s office, Oct.-Nov., 1907 and Sept.-Nov., 1910; senr. asst. treas., Nov., 1908; ch. asst. treas., Apr., 1917; ag. treas. and currency offr., July-Oct., 1919 and Dec., 1920 to Aug., 1921; dep. treas., Jan., 1920; commanded G. Coast Volunteers, 1914 and during War; ment. in desps., Aug., 1917; col. treas. and currency offr., Sierra Leone, Aug., 1922; treas., Dominica, 1932; treas. and collr., cust., St. Helena, Mar., 1933.

BARTON, T., M.A.—B. 1904; qualified teacher Scottish educn. dept.; inspr., schls., Gold Coast, Oct., 1928.

BARWELL, HON. SIR HENRY NEWMAN, K.C.M.G. (1922), LL.B. (Adelaide Univ.), Barrister-at-Law.—B. 1877; ed. St. Peter's Coll., Adelaide; mem., H. of A., S. Australia, Stanley dist., 1915-25; atty.-gen., 1917 and 1918-20; premier and atty.-gen., 1920-24; fedl. Senator, 1925; agt. gen. for S. Australia, 1928.

BASSETT, JOHN HAROLD, Barrister-at-law, Middle Temple.—B. 1896; ed. Wallacey and Glasgow Univ.; war serv., 1914-19; priv. sec., dep. contrlr. (organisation), Min. of Lab., 1919-20; cadet, F.M.S., May, 1921; mag., Klang, Jan., 1922; town planning admtr. and state valuer, Ipoh, Mar., 1927; offr., cls IV, Oct., 1927; regsr., sup. ct., Penang, Oct., 1931; offr., cls III, Oct., 1932; dep. pub. pros., S'pore, Apr., 1933; ag. solr.-gen., S.S., Mar., 1934.

BASSETT, RALPH HENRY.—B. 1896; on mily. serv., Sept., 1914; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1920; addl. to Ratnapura Kuch., Jan., 1921; ag. pol. mag., Jaffna, May, 1922; asst. sttlmt. offr., July, 1925; pol. mag., Colombo, June, 1930; asst. govt. agt., Nuwara Eliya, Oct., 1933.

BATEMAN, G. S., L.D.S., R.S.C., Eng.—Serv. with Forces in E. Africa 1915 and 1916; dental surg., Uganda, May, 1912.

BATES, ISAAC GRAINGER.—B. 1886; barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn, 1909; equity bar, 1909-13; ch. mag. and legal adviser, Br. Solomon Is. Prot., with jurisdiction as a juill. comsnr. for the Western Pacific, Nov., 1913; ag. res. comsnr. in addn. during 1919; seconded for serv. as ch. pol. mag., Fiji, May, 1920 to Dec., 1921; senr. mag., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1922; ag. judge, high ct., for various periods, 1924-33; ag. solr.-gen., July to Oct., 1927; puisne judge, Apr., 1934.

BATHO, CHARLES PHILIP ARTHUR, M.B.E. (1920).—B. 1883; ed. Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey, and Victoria Coll., Jersey; control and audit office, Cape Colony, 1900; sec., tender bd., 1901; transf. Transvaal prisons dept., July, 1902; prin. clk., July 1910; prin. clk., Union prisons dept., Nov., 1912; ch. clk., Nov., 1917; asst. dir. prisons, Apr., 1926; is also comsnr. of oaths for Union; sp. grade supt., Pretoria cent. prison and Pretoria gaol and outstations and warden, Baviaanspoort farm col. and inebriate reformatory, 1930; do., Johannesburg gaol and outstations and warden, Leeuwkop farm col., Jan., 1934.

BATTERBEE, SIR HARRY F., K.C.M.G. (1921), K.C.V.O. (1927), C.M.G. (1918), C.V.O. (1915), B. 1880; ed. at Grammar Schls., Faversham and at Oxford; classical scholar, Hertford Coll., 1898-1904; 1st cls. class. moda., 1901; 1st cls. math. moda., 1901; 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1904; apptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., exchequer and audit dept., Jan., 1906; 2nd cls. clk., C.C., May, 1906; ag. 1st cls. clk., 4th June, 1916; 1st cls. clk., 6th July, 1917; sec. to W. Afr. comm. lands comtec., 1912; asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Lew., (now Lord) Harcourt, 9th Dec., 1912; priv. sec. to Lord Islington, 12th Oct., 1914; priv. sec. to Mr. (now Sir Arthur) Steel-Maitland, 31st Mar., 1916; priv. sec. to Mr. Walter Long, 11th Dec., 1916 to 13th Jan., 1919; priv., 1st Apr. 1921; asst. sec., 1st Mar., 1923; polit. sec. to Admincmdg. sp. serv. squadron during Empire cruze, 1923-24; asst. sec., 12th Dec., 1924; polit. sec. to H.R.H. the Duke of York during his visit to Australia and N.Z., 1927; asst. under sec. of state for dom. affrs. 25th Jan., 1930; dep. sec. Imp. Conf., 1930; regiar., Order of St. Michael and St. George since 1930.

BATTERSHILL, WILLIAM DENIS.—B. 1865; on mily. serv., Aug., 1914-19; cadet Ceylon, Apr., 1920; addl. to Colombo cust., May, 1923; addl. to Badulla kach., Jan., 1921; office ass't. Badulla kach., Mar., 1921; pol. mag., Panatana Oct., 1922; dep. fiscal, Colombo, June, 1925; addnl. asst. col. sec., Jan., 1925; 4th asst. col. sec., Mar., 1925; 3rd asst. col. sec., May, 1926; 2nd asst. col. sec. and clk., leg. coun. May, 1926; asst. col. sec., Jamaica, 1926; ag. col. sec. on various occasions, 1929-32; col. sec., Cyprus 1934.

BATTISCOMBE, CHRISTOPHER FRANCIS O.B.E. (1930).—B. 1890; ed. King's Schl., Canterbury, and Haileybury Coll.; schol., Lincoln coll., Oxford; B.A., (hons.) 1914; asst. dist. commr., E.A.P., 1914; served with R. Berks. Regt., Grenadier Guards during European War; apptd. in col. serv. cancelled on acct. of wounds, 1st re-enl. col. serv. as headmnr., Machakos misc. schl. and inspr. of schls., Ukamba prov., K. Africa, 1921; tutor to Prince Seyyid Abduilla, son of the sultan of Zanzibar, 1922; sec. to sultan 1923; admtr. offr., Zanzibar, 1923; Order of the Brilliant Star of Zanzibar, 4th cls., 1924; addl. as ptve. sec. to suite of Sultan on state visit to England, 1929; clk., couns., June, 1930; sec. offr. gaz., July, 1930 and July, 1933; agt. prin., D.O., 18th Mar., 1932; 1st amt. sec. secretariat, Nov., 1932.

BAVERSTOCK, WILLIAM CHARLES BETR., R. of O., K.R.R.C.—Ed. Wimborne Grammar Schl. and Milton Abbas Grammar Schl., Earlsford; overseer, Pacific Phosphate Co. F. Phosphate Coman.), 1905; served, Great War, Queen's Own Dorset Yeomanry, Dorset Regt., K.R.R.C., Aug., 1914 - July, 1919; min. of munitions, 1919; dist. offr., Gilbert and Ellerton Col., Jan., 1920; dep. commr., W. P. legs. comm., 1920.

BAVIN, HON. SIR THOMAS RAINFORD, K.C.M.G. (1933), K.C., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1874; ed. Auckland, N.Z. and at Sydney Univ.; called to bar, 1897; prof. of law, Univ. of Tasmania 1900; sec. to prime min. C. of A., 1901-4; M.I.A., N.S.W., from 1917; premier and co-treasurer, N.S.W., 1927-30.
BAXTER, JOHN BABINGTON MACAULEY, K.C., D.C.L.—Elected to New Brunswick Legislature, 1911; atty.-gen., 1914; leader of provincial opposition, 1920; min. of int. in Dom. govt., 1921; prime min., New Brunswick, 1925; judge, sup. ct., N.B., 1931.

BAYLES, HERBERT LAURENCE.—B. 1886; ed. Dulwich Coll.; clk., C.A.'s office, 1905; olk., const. serv., Nyassaland, 1909; P.W.D., 1910; Nyassaland Field Force, 1914; ast. finan. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1916-17; ast. treas., Zanzibar, 1921; dep. treas., Kenya, Mar., 1924; treas., Trinidad and chmn., agrl. bank, May, 1931; treas. and currency offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1933.

BAYNES, EDWARD WILLIAM, C.B.E. (1928), O.B.E. (1920).—B. 1880; clk., G.P.O., Antigua, Jan., 1899; olk. to comntr., Virgin Islds., Jan., 1901; priv. sec. and olk. to adminstr. Dominica, Aug., 1909; transf'd, to Impl. civ. ser. and apptd. 2nd cl. clk., National Health Insurance Comm. (England), June, 1912; 1st cl. clk., May, 1913; priv. sec. to sec., ministry of shipping, Jan., 1917; sec., National Health Insurance Joint Comttee., Oct., 1919; priv. sec. to parly. sec., ministry of shipping, Apr., 1920 to Mar., 1921; suptg. clk., Min. of Health, Oct., 1920; sec., "Discovery" comttee., C.O., July, 1923; col. sec., Leeward Is., Oct., 1925; admtd. govt. of Antigua on numerous occasions; ag. gov., Leeward Is., on various occasions, 1930-34.

BAYNES, THOMAS EDWIN PERCIVAL, O.B.E. (1932).—B. 1884; ed. St. Kitts Grammar Schl. and Queen's Royal Coll., Trinidad; clerical astt., col. sec.'s off., Trinidad, 1903; 6th clk., C.S.O., 1903; 5th clk., C.S.O., 1906; 1st clk., post office, Antigua, 1907; 3rd clk., C.S.O., 1911; ag. olk. to adminstr., Dominica, 1912; 2nd clk., C.S.O., clk. of exec. and legis. councils, Antigua, and supt. of govt. printing office, 1912; clk. to adminstr., and clk. to exec. and legis. couns., Dominica, 1919; offr. in ch. (later, warden), N. dist., 1924; temp. mem., leg. coun., Dominica, Feb., 1926; O.A.G., Montserrat, in Mar., 1926 and Apr., 1928; O.A.G., Virgin Is., Aug. to Nov., 1926; offl. mem., leg. coun., Dominica in 1927 and 1928; ag. astt. col. sec., Leeward Is., Apr., Sept., 1927; treas., Dominica, June, 1928; offl. mem., exec. coun., Dominica, June, 1928; O.A.G., Montserrat, June-Sept., 1929; O.A.G., Dominica on three occasions in 1929, 1930 and 1931; comntr., Montserrat, 1932.

BAZELL, C.—B. 1885; ed. Christ's Hosp. and Keble Coll., Oxford (scholar 1904-08); B.A. 1908 (2nd hon. moda., 2nd lit. hum.); astt. mast., Raffles Inst., Spore, 1914-17 and 1922; headmast., Malay Coll., K. Kangsar, 1923.

BEAL, KEAR-ADML. ALISTER FRANCIS, C.B. (1926), C.M.G. (1919), R.N.—B. 1875; ed. H.M.S. "Britannia," Dartmouth; comdr., H.M.S. "Princess Royal," 1912-15; capt., 1915; served on Admty. war staff, 1915-18; in command H.M.S. "Weymouth," 1918-19 and 1920-21; dep. dir., operations divn., Admty. naval staff, 1921-23; commodore commdg. N.Z. squadron and naval adviser to N.Z. Govt., 1923-26; offr., Legion of Honour, 1919; Italian Silver Med. for mily. valour, 1918.

BEARDMORE, ERNEST.—B. 1882; ed. Manchester and Capetown; B.A. (1907); LL.B. (1911); clk., Cape civ. serv., 1900; prof. astt. and ch. clk., solr.-gen., Cape, 1920; solr.-gen., Cape, 1931; crown pros., Witwatersrand, 1933.

BEATLEY, FRANK EDWARD MAMERTUS.—B. 1882; ed. Lucton Grammar Schl.; traffic sup., Mauritius govt. rly., 1914; dep. traffic man., Sierra Leone rly., Jan., 1925; traffic man., 1930; gen. man. and traffic man., 1933.

BEATTIE, Lieut.-Col. ALEXANDER ELDER, C.M.G. (1933), C.B.E. (1920), M.C. (1915), ret. pay (res. of offrs.).—Entd. Army (Argyll and Sutherland Highlands), 1906; transfd. on promotion to the Queen's (now The Queen's Royal) Regt., 1908; served in Aden and India; seconded for serv. with W.A.F.F., 1911; astt. adjutant, Southern Nigeria Regt., 1912; ag. regtl. adjutant, S.N. Regt., 1913; adjutant, 4th Bn. Nigeria Regt., 1914; capt., 1914; Cameroons Expedy. Force, 1914; staff offr. to various field columns, 1914-15; ment. in despe., 1914; M.C., 1915; severely wounded, 1915; astt. staff offr., W.A.F.F., Col. Office, 1915; staff offr. (gen. staff offr.), W.A.F.F., 1916; temp. major, 1916; offr. staff offr., K.A.R., 1916; promoted major by brevet, 1918; tempy. lieut. col., 1918; C.B.E., 1920; accompanied inspr.-gen., W.A.F.F., on tour of inspection, Nigeria, Gold Coast, Sierra Leone and Gambia, 1920; C.O. rep. on various inter-depl. comtees, 1918-21; ret. with rank of lieut.-col., Sept., 1922; reed. thanks of S. of S. for services under the C.O.; astt. sec., Gibraltar, Sept., 1922; res. inspr. of schls., Oct., 1922; clk. of exec. coun., Oct., 1922; sec. bd. of educn. (ex officio), 1922; local secy., Cambridge Univ. exams. (ex officio), 1922; ag. D.P.W. on two occasions; col. sec., Falkland Is., 8th Oct., 1925; ag. gov. from May, 1926 to Apr., 1927; ch. astt. col. sec., Cyprus, 8th Aug., 1927; ag. col. sec., on various occasions, 1927-29; col. sec., Gibraltar, Jan., 1930.

BEATTIE, JAMES, O.B.E. (1934).—B. 1891; European War, 1914-18; Somaliland Camel Corps, 1918-20; M.C., 1920; dist. pol. offr., Somaliland, 1920; dist. comntr., 1922; comdt., pol., Oct., 1928.

BEATTIE, Sir JOHN CARRUTHERS, K.T. (1920), F.R.S.E. and S.A., D.Sc., LL.D. (Ed. and Wits).—B. 1866; ed. Moray House, Edinburgh Univ.; Vans Dunlop schl. in Physics, 1861 Exhibn. Schi., Univ. of Munich, Vienna, Berlin and Glasgow; prof. of physics, S. African Coll., 1897; medallist S. African Assoctn. for Advancement of Science, 1910; crossed Africa from Cape Town to Cairo with Prof. J. T. Morrison on magnetic survey; chmn., survey comen., 1921; pres., S. African Assoctn. for Advancement of Science, 1928; prin., S. African Coll., 1917-18; prin. and vice-chane., Univ. of Cape Town since 1918; prin. publns.: rept. of a Magnetic Survey of S. Africa, Cambridge, 1909, and (in conjunction with Prof. J. T. Morrison) "On Magnetic Work in Southern and Central Africa," Washington, 1913.

BEATTY, Sir KENNETH JAMES, K.T. BACH. (1926).—B. 1878; ed. Univ. High Schl. and Melbourne Univ.; qualified Victorian bar, 1900; Transvaal law certif. (including Roman Dutch law), 1904; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1908; served in S. African war as lieut., V.M.I., wounded in action (Queen's med. and 4 clasps); apptd. pub. pros., Transvaal, Nov., 1902; addtnl. astt. res. mag., Mar., 1903; astt. res. mag., Dec., 1905; astt., Natal Carbineers, Natal rebellion, 1906; reed. thanks of Natal govt., med. and clasp; pol. mag., master of sup. ct. and registr.-gen., Sierra Leone, Sept., 1908; has acted as ch. just., circuit judge and atty.-gen., Sierra Leone; on mily. serv., 1915-18; puisme judge, Gold Coast, 1921; ch. just., Bermuda, 1924; ch. just., Bahamas, 1927; dep. gov. in, 1928.; ch. just., Gibraltar, 1931.

BEAUBRUN, IGNATIUS CECIL.—B. 1889; treasy. clk., St. Lucia, 1906; astt. audit clk., 1907;
rev. offr., St. Vincent, 1912; ag. audit clk., 1910 and 1912; rev. offr., Grenada, 1915; 3rd treas. clk., 1916; ch. clk., treas. and commr. of income tax, 1922; ast. treas., 1929; col. treas., collr. of cust., supt. of inld. rev., ch. of excise, Grenada, June, 1930; ag. col. sec. and regisr.-gen., June, 1932.

BEAUCHAMP, 7th Earl (creat. 1815), Visct. Elmley (1815). Baron Beauchamp (creat. 1806, U.K.); K.G.; K.C.M.G. (1899); William Lygon; B. 1872; succeeded his father, 1891.—Ed. Eton and Chr. Ch., Oxford; D.L. Worcestershire; Mayor of Worcester, 1895-6; mem. London schl. bd., 1897-9; gov. N.S.W., 1899 to 1900; capt. of hon. corps of Gentlemen-at-Arms, 1906; first commr. of works, 1911-14; lord-pres. of the coun., 1910-15.

BEAUCHAMP, ARTHUR KENNETH.—B. 1888; ed. Worcester Cath., King's Schol. and Christ Church, Oxford, B.A., 3rd cls. math. hons., 1910; headmr., gram. schl. and sub-inspr., schls., Dominica, Sept., 1912; ag. inspr., schls., Leeward Is., July-Oct., 1916; inspr., schls., St. Lucia, Jan., 1921; ast. educn., S. Provin., Nigeria, 1926.

BEAUCHESENE, ARTHUR, M.A., K.C., LL.D., Litt.D., F.R.S.C.—B. 1876; ed. St. Joseph's (class. course), Memramcook, N.B.; grad. as B.A., M.A. and Litt.D. valedictorian, 1895; studied law, Laval, Montreal; admitted to bar, Quebec, 1904; K.C., 1914; legal adviser, justice dept., 1913-16; clk. astt., House of Commons, Canada, and commr. to admstr. oath of allegiance to M. of P.; olk., House of Commons, 1925; author of "Beauchesne's Parliamentary Rules and Forms," "Ecrivains d'Autrefois," etc.

BECK, DAVID MACDONALD HERBERT, M.C.—B. 1891; ed. Weymouth Coll. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; temp. lieut., W.A.F.F., Feb., 1917; admstr. offr., Nigeria, Jan., 1919; dep. res., Apr., 1933; admstr. offr., cls. I, 1935.

BECK, EWALL EGERTON HERBERT.—B. 1894; ed. Weymouth Coll., Dorset; pol. probtnr., F.M.S., Oct., 1914; ast. astnt. commr. pol., Selangor, Feb., 1923; suplt., convict estabtn., Taiping and inspr., prisons, F.M.S., Sept., 1923; offr. i/o, pol. dist., Kuantan, Aug., 1927; comdt. pol., depot, K. Lumpur, Mar., 1929; suplt., pol. S.S., Oct., 1931; ch. pol. offr., N. Semban, Feb., 1932.

BECKETT, HAROLD.—B. 1891; ed. at Monmouth Grammar Schol. and Oxford; exhibtioner at Wadham Coll., 1910-1914; also Symons exhibitioner, 1912-1914; 1st cls. Class. Moda., 1912; 3rd cls. Lit. Hum., 1914; B.A., 1914; apptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 30th Nov., 1914; ast. priv. sec. to Lord Milner, 14th Jan. to 16th Mar., 1919; ag. 1st cls. clk., 17th July, 1919; priv. sec. to perm. under sec. (Sir G. Fiddes), 1st Jan., 1920; prin., 1st Apr., 1920; mem. W. Indies currency comte., 1923; sent to Mauritius as spec. commr. to enquire into and rept. to S. of S. on questions of currency and exchange, Apr., 1923; returned to C.O., Oct., 1925; ag. astnt. sec., 28th Sept., 1931.

BECKETT, HERBERT JAMES RUST, A.C.A.—B. 1885; treas., N. Borneo, Feb., 1911; dist. treas., Apr., 1911; mag., 1st cls., Apr., 1914; seconded for mil. serv., 1916-19; dist. offr., Aug., 1919; ast. commr., cust. and excise, Mar., 1921; ast. commr., excise, Feb., 1926; auditor, Mar., 1929; finance contr., Dec., 1930.

BEDINGTON, GUY CYRIL, A.M.I.C.E., F.S.I., M.I.M. & Cy. E., M.R.San.l., Chtd. Civ. Engrnr. and Chtd. Survr.—B. 1889; ed. Univ. of Bristol; ast. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., July, 1913; exec. engrnr., Ipoh, 1922; ag. senr. exec. engrnr., Kuantan, 1927; attd. ch. hydrlc. engrnr.'s office, K. Lumpur, Nov., 1929; ag. senr. exec. engrnr. waterworks, K. Lumpur, Oct., 1930; ar. exec. engrnr., F.M.S. & S.S., Klang, 1932; sr. exec. engrnr., wks. and bldgs., K. Lumpur, Apr., 1935.

BEECHING, HERBERT.—Seconded from Basutoland service; apptd. ag. sub-inspr., Bechuanaland Prot. pol., Dec., 1920; ag. astnt. res. mag., 1921; ag. res. mag., 1923; passed 1st grade Secwana exam., 1926; sub. inspr., Bec. Prot. pol., July, 1927; hon. rank inspr., Nov., 1927.

BEBGIE, RALPH STOCKMAN, M.D., D.P.H., D.T.M. and H. (Edin.).—Health offr., med. dept., Hong Kong, 1930; ag. malarialogist, 1931; ast. bacteriologist, 1932; ag. bacteriologist, 1933.

BELAND, HON. HENRI SEVRIN.—B. 1865; ed. Three Rivers (Que.), Coll. (B.A.), Laval Univ. (M.D.); physician; mayor of St. Joseph, 1910; el. to leg. ass., Quebec, 1897 and 1901; el. H.C. bye-el., 1902; re-el., 1904, 1908, 1911, 1915, and 1921; postm.-gen. in Sir Wilfrid Laurier govt., Aug. 19th until resignation of govt., Oct. 6th, 1911; served with the Belgian forces in the early part of the war, and made prisoner of war; x.x. of soldiers' civ. re-set. and health in Kivu; admtnr., Dec., 1921; called to senate, 1925.

BELCHER, SIR CHARLES FREDERIC, Kt. Bart. (1931), O.B.E. (1923), M.B.E. (1919), M.A. LL.B.—B. 1876; ed. at Geelong Gram. Schol. and Trin. Coll., Melbourne (final scholarship in classics and comp. philology, Shakespeare scholarship); admitted to practise, Victoria Oct., 1902; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, June, 1909 (cert. of honour); conveyancer, Uganda Prot., July, 1914; custodian of enemy property, Uganda, Apr., 1915; mag., Uganda, June, 1915; ast. judge, Zanzibar, June, 1920; judge of H.B.M. ct. of appeal for E. Africa, Aug., 1920 and June, 1925; atty. gen., Nyasaland, Sept., 1926; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; ag. judge, high ct., Nairob. 1921 to Jan., 1922; judge, high ct., May, 1924; ast. just., sup. ct., Cyprus, May, 1927; ch. just Trinidad, 1930.

BELGRAVE, WILLIAM NORMAN CUMMING, B.A. (Cantab.), Camb. Univ. Dip. of Agr., B. 1891; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and St. John's Coll., Cambridge; ast. mycologist, agr. dept., F.M.S., Oct., 1914; plant physiologist, Jan., 1920; B. 1891; ch. divn. of soils and agr. physiology, Feb., 1927; deleg. to internat. soc. of soil science, Konigsberg, 1929; deleg., 2nd int. mycological conf., London, 1929; ast. to ch. in admn., June, 1930; in ch., divn. of agr. chem. in admn., Sept., 1930; ch. resch. offr., Sept., 1931.

BELL, ALAN MALCOLM.—B. 1895; ed. Warwick, Ireland and Bedford; junr. astnt. govt laboratory, Leeward Is., 1923; clk., col. sec. office, 1924; sub.-inspr., pol., and adjt., local forces, 1927; sub.-inspr., constab., Trinidad, 1928; A.D.C. to govt., 1930-31; local commr. pol., Cyprus, 1934.

BELL, HON. LIEUT.-COL. EDWARD, O.B.E. (1924), M.B.E. (1918), V.D.—Served in R.I.C., Dec., 1886 to Aug., 1896; attached 2nd Batt. Durham Light Infantry, 1896; Hythe certif. of musketry and instr. certif., Maxim machine gun; drill instr. to local force, St. Kitts Nevis, 12th Aug., 1896; ag. inspr., L. Islda. police and adjt., St. Kitts-Nevis defence force, 1896; inspr., L. Islda. police, Sept., 1898; and capt. and adjt. defence force; ag. inspr.-gen., L. Islda. police, and ag. inspecting offr. of defence forces of colony, Apr. to Nov., 1903; ag. inspr.-gen., L. Islda. police, 1st Apr., 1906, subsequently confirmed in commd. of force as chief inspr.; commd. local forces, with local rank of lieut.-col.
extra A.D.C. to gov. Sir Bickham Scott, 1912; mem. exec. coun., Leeward Is., 1915; police medal, 1915; recd. thanks of H.M.'s Govt., for services rendered during riot and disturbances in Antigua in March, 1918; is a J.P.

BELL, EDWARD PETER STUBBS.—B. 1902; 4th clk., col. sec.'s office, Antigua, 1920; snr. clk., 1927; clk. to atty. gen., 1927; clk., ex. and leg. couns., Antigua, 1927; pvt. sec. to gov., Leeward Is., June, 1929 to Apr., 1930; seconded for duty in connec. with relief measures, Antigua, June-Nov., 1931; mag., dist. F and afterwards dist. E, Dominica, Nov., 1931; mag., dist. D and addnl. mag., dist. C., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1934; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1934; ag. comnr., Montserrat, July to Sept., 1934.

BELL, RT. HON. SIR FRANCIS HENRY DILLON, P.C. (1926), G.C.M.G. (1923), K.C.M.G. (1915), K.C.—B. 1851; B.A., Camb.; barrister, Middle Temple, 1874; mem. N.Z. H. of R., 1893-96; M.L.C. since 1912; leader of legis. coun., 1912-26 and 1927-28; min. of internal affairs, 1912 and 1920; min. of immigr. in National ministry, 1915; also leader of legis. coun.; atty.-gen., 1918-26; min. of educn., min. of public health and min. of immigr., 1919-20; comnr. of state forests, 1919-22; min. of marine, 1921-22; min. of just., Jan. to June, 1923-26; min. of external affrs., 1923; prime min., 14th-30th May, 1925; mem. of exec. coun., without portfolio, 1926-28; min. of marine, 1928; ret. from office, 1928.

BELL, MAJOR G. H., M.C., Officer Legion d'Honneur.—B. 1885; entered army, 1906; India, 1907-9; Nigeria, W.A.F.F., 1911; asst. dir. of surveys, Nigeria, 1912-14; served in France, 1914-16; Palestine and Syria, 1917-18; dep. ch. polit. offr., Egyptian Expedy Force, 1919; G.S.O. Intelligence, E.E.F., 1920; dir. topographical branch, Gold Coast Survey, 1920.

BELL, SIR HENRY HENKETH JOUDDU, G.C.M.G. (1925), K.C.M.G. (1908), C.M.G. (1903).—B. 1865; ed. in Paris; 3rd clk. gov.in-chief's office, Barbados, May, 1882; transferred to treasy. dept., Grenada, 1883; supervisor of customs, G. Coast, Jan., 1890; sen. asst. treas., G. Coast, Aug., 1891; ag. dist. comnr. and sheriff, Accra, 1892; ag. col. treas., 1893 rec-gen., Bahamas, Dec., 1894; represented Harbour Iald. in House of Assem., 1895-6; ag. col. sec., July to Oct., 1897, Apr. to Nov., 1898; admnr. of Dominica, Aug., 1899; ag. gov., Leeward Is., Aug., 1904, and from June, 1905; comnr. and comdr.-in-chief, Uganda Prot., Jan., 1906; gov., ditto, Oct., 1907; gov., N. Nigeria, Oct., 1909; gov. Leeward Is., 1912; gov., Mauritius, Jan., 1916; assumed gov't, May, 1916; author of "Geography of the Gold Coast," "Obeah," etc.

BELL, P. S., M.B., B.S., M.R.C.P. (Lond.), M.R.C.S., D.T.M. & H. (Lond.).—B. 1897; mily. serv., 1915-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1926.

BELLANTI, J. J., LL.D., Malta Univ., 1910.—B. 1885; ed. St. Ignatius' Coll., Malta; matric. (3rd place in hon. list), Malta Univ., 1902; clk., civil serv., Malta, 1907; mem. of coun. of govt., 1911; asst. crown advocate, Gozo, 1914; assessor of taxes, Malta treasy., Apr., 1923.

BENHAM, JOHN ELLIOTT.—B. 1886; war service, German and Portuguese E. Africa, Mar., 1917 to Dec., 1918; asst. dist. comnr., Sierra Leone, Apr., 1914; dist. comnr., Aug., 1922; asst. col. sec., Jan., 1925; J.P., 1926; ag. ch. asst. col. sec. on many occasions; ag. col. sec. on several occasions; gov't dep. on two occasions.

BENJAMIN, JOHN.—B. 1888; ed. Christ's Hosp., Lond. and Horsham; Br. P.O., Oct., 1903-Dec., 1913; postal clk. and telegraphist, Sept., 1913; ast. ch. acctnt., G.P.O., E. Africa Prot., Apr., 1918; 1st cls. patmstr., Kenya, Apr., 1920; dep. ch. acctnt., June, 1924; 1st P.M.G., July, 1931; snr. acctnt., S.S. and F.M.S., Aug., 1932.

BENNETT, HON. SIR JOHN ROBERT, K.B.E. (1916).—M.H.A., St. John's West, Newf'dld., 1904; M.E.C., 1913; col. sec., 1913; mem., defence comte., 1915; deputy chief censor, telegraphs and cables, 1914; press censor, 1915; min. of militia, 1917.

BENNETT, RT. HON. RICHARD BEDFORD, P.C. (1930), P.C. (Can.), LL.B., K.C.—B. 1870; ed. pub. and high schls., N.E., Dalhousie Univ., N.S.; hon. degree LL.D., Dalhousie Univ., Queen's Univ. and Univ. of Alberta; admitted to bar of N.B., 1903; mem., legis. assem., Northwest Territories, 1898-1905; legis. assem. of Alta., 1909; rep. Calgary in H. of C. Canada, 1911-17; min. of just. and atty.-gen., 1921; min. of finance in Meighen admin., 1926; leader of conserv. party, Oct., 1927; prime min. of Canada after g.e., June, 1930.

BENNETT, SYDNEY CHRISTMAS, A.M.I.C.E., A.M.Inst. Mun. and Cty. Engrns.—Ed. Sherborne Schl.; ast. engr., P.W.D., R.A.P., 1914-16; pioneer, E. A. Pioneers, 1915-16; 2nd lieut., R.A. Rly. Corps, 1916-12; lt., 1917-18; ment. in despatches, "1914-15" Star, Br. War and Victory medals; exec. engr., Kenya, 1921.

BENNETTS, ALBERT THOMAS.—B. 1890; ed. Camborne Schl. of Mines, 1908-11; medallist of the Royal Cornwall Polytechnic Soc'y., 1910; 1st cls. bona. and silver medallist, City and Guilds of London Inst., 1911; 1st cls. diploma, Camborne Schl. of Mines, 1911; mines dept., F.M.S., 1912-25; ast. ward., mines, Perak, Nov., 1929; senr. inspr., mines, Jan., 1931.

BENSON, GEORGE ALLEN RALSTON.—B. 1879; 6th cls. offr., cust., Br. Guiana, 1901; 5th cls., 1904; 4th cls., 1911; 3rd cls., 1915; 2nd cls., 1924; 1st cls., 1925; ast. survr., cust., 1926; survr., cust., B. Guiana, 1927.

BENSON, SIR J. HAWTREY, KT. BACH. (1912), A.B., M.D., F.R.C.P. Irel.—Ed. Trin. Coll., Dublin; 1st hons. maths., graduated, 1861; consulting physician to Royal City of Dublin Hosp. and to the Monkstown Hosp. Fellow of Acad. of Med., Ireland; late censor and examr., Royal Coll. of Phys., Ireland, and late external examr. in med., Dub. Univ.; is now med. advsr. for Ireland to C.O.; author of numerous papers and articles on technical med. subjects; ret., 1926.

BENTINCK, LILLIE JOSEPHINE, M.B., B.Ch., certif. L.S.T.M.—Lady med. offr., B. Gajah, May, 1921; Ipoh, July, 1921; K. Pilah, July, 1923; Taiping, Apr., 1925; K. Kangsar, June, 1925; lady med. offr., infant welfare centre, Taiping, Aug., 1925; Seremban, July, 1926; K. Lumpur, Sept., 1927; Ipoh, Nov., 1927.

BENTINCK, MAJOR WALTER GUY, BARON, C.M.G. (1912), D.S.O. (1902).—Ed. at Marlborough Coll., Jena Univ., Germany, and Royal Mil. Coll., Sandhurst; joined Rifle Brig., 1885; capt., 1894; major, 1902; ret., 1905; intelligence dept., W.O., 1899; served throughout S. African war, 1899-1902; (ment. in despatches, Queen's medal with six clasps, King's medal with two clasps); dist. comnr., Vereeniging, 1900; res. mag., Wakkerstroom dist., Transvaal, 1901-1907; Transvaal mem. of Natal-Transvaal boundary comnr., 1909; sec. in office of high comnr. for S. Africa, 1907;
ag. Imperial sec., Aug., 1907, to Mar., 1908; ast. Imperial sec., Apr., 1908; chmn., Swansea water comm., 1909.

BENZIES, DOUGLAS, M.A., B.Sc.—B. 1899; ed. Heriot's Sch., Edinburgh; Edin. Univ., 1919-25; M.A., B.Sc.; France, June-Dec., 1918; demob., Jan., 1919; ast. mast., Achimota, Gold Coast, 1925.

BEKENDSEN, CARL AUGUST, LL.M.—B. 1890; ed. Australian pub. schls., Gore Dist. High Schl. (N.Z.) and Victoria Univ. Coll.; entd. N.Z. educ. dept., 1906; lab. dept., 1916; chf. elk., 1917; dep. reg. industrial unions, 1919; Imperial affrs. offr., prime min.'s dept., 1926; sec., external affrs., 1928.

BERNE, CAPT. JAMES LEO, O.B.E. (1918).—B. 1883; ed. Dulwich Coll.; 2nd Lieut., Royal Irish Regt., 1904; capt., 1910; served with Sierra Leone Batt., W.A.F.F., 1907-1912; served with Franco-Liberian bdry. commn., 1908 (reed. thanks of French govt.); served with Anglo-French bdry. commn., 1911; capt., R. of O.; ast. dist. commn., Somaliland Prot., Sept., 1912; dist. commn., March, 1914; served with Admiralty war staff, intell. div., Apr. to Aug., 1916; accompanied mission to Abyssinia on the occasion of coronation of Empress Zauditu, 1917; 3rd cls. Star of Ethiopia, 1917; sen. ast. sec. to govt. of Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1921; ag. ast. ch. sec., Sept., 1922 to May, 1923, Dec., 1923 to March, 1924; ag. prov. commn., Apr., 1930 to May, 1931 and Feb., 1932; dep. prov. commn., Feb., 1931; mem. leg. coun., 1931; prov. commn., 1934.

BERTREAU, F. C., I.S.O. (1914).—Ed. Victoria Coll., Jersey, 1865-72; ent. Newfoundland civ. ser. as clk. H.M. Customs, 1878; collr. of cust., Labrador, 1881; clk. in col. sec.'s off., 1889; ch. clk., 1890; J.P. for col., 1893; mission to Ottawa to inquire into Canadian fin. system, with view of applying same to Newf., May, 1898; audr.-gen. Newf., July, 1898; ag. cashier, Newfoundland savings bank, 1911.

BERTRAM, SIR ANTON, KT. BACH. (1916); K.C. (1913).—Ed. at City of London sch., and Camb.; scholar of Caius Coll., 1887; Fellow, 1891; 1st cl. class. trip, part I, 1890; ditto, part II., 1891; Powis medal for Latin verse; Chancellor's medal for classics, 1891; B.A., 1890; M.A., 1892; president, Union Soc., 1891; Tancred law studentship, Lincoln's Inn, 1890; called, 1893; atty.-gen., Bahamas, 1902; elected to H. of Assem., June, 1903; ag. col. sec., May to Sept., 1903; admstd. govt., Sept. to Oct., 1905; ag. ch. justice, Sep.-Nov., 1906; chmn. of comm. on the Out Is., 1906; puisne judge, Cyprus, 1906; atty.-gen., Ceylon, 19th May, 1911; mem. of exec. and legis. couns.; ag. ch. justice, Apr., 1918; ch. justice, July, 1919; services lent to govt. of Palestine, Dec., 1920 to May, 1921; ret., 1925; joint author, "Handbook to Workmen's Compensation Acts, 1897 and 1900."

BESBOROUGH, 9TH EARL OF (creat. 1739), Rt. Hon. VISCOUNT BONSONBY, P.C. (1931), G.C.M.G. (1913), C.M.G. (1919), B.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1880; 2nd lieut., Bucks. I.Y., 1905-8; temp. capt., Suffolk yeo. and adjutant, 1915; served in Great War, 1914-18; L.C.C., 1907-10; M.P., Cheltenham, 1910 and Dover, 1913-20; J.P., Co. Kilkenny; gov.-gen. of the Dominion of Canada, 1931.

BEST, HON. SIR ROBERT WALLACE, K.C.M.G. (1908).—B. 1856; vice-pres. of the exec. coun., Australian Commonwealth; leader of the Deakin govt. in the Senate, Feb., 1907; min. for trade and customs, C. of A., 1909; now retd.

BEST, SIR THOMAS ALEXANDER VAN, K.C.M.G. (1932), K.B.E. (1926), C.M.G. (1916), C.B.E. (1918).—B. 1870; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Magdalen Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1894; Taylorian Univ. scholar; gold medalist of French Ministry of pub. instruction; ast. Cent. Africa admin., 1896; judicial offr., Mar., 1898; ag. ch. judicial offr., Nov., 1899, to Mar., 1900; ag. vice-consul, Chinde, Aug., 1902 to Apr., 1903; ag. dep. commn., Apr. to Dec., 1903, and June, 1905, to Jan., 1906; dist. rep., 1st cls., Apr., 1906; col. sec., Falkland Is., Oct., 1909; ag. gov. Dec., 1909, to Dec., 1910; attended Impl. Educat. Confce., 1911; col. sec., Leeward Is., Jan., 1913; ag. gov., May to Sept., 1914, Apr. to Aug., 1915, and from Jan., 1916, to Mar., 1919; recd. thank of H.M.'s Govt. for services during disturbances in Antigua in Mar., 1918; col. sec., Trinidad, Aug., 1919; ag. gov., June-Aug., 1920, June, 1921 to Jan., 1922, June to Oct., 1923 and from Aug., 1924; lieut.-gov., Malta, 1925; O.A.G. for various periods in 1926, 1927, 1928 and 1929; gov., Windward Is., Sept., 1930; ret., 1933.

BETANCOURT, NELSON.—B. 1887; sworn surv.; 2nd ast. inspr. of mines, Trinidad, April, 1909; 1st inspr., mines, Apr., 1921; ag. inspr., mines, May to Sent., 1927 and Mar., 1933.

BETHEL, CHARLES PERCEVAL, I.S.O. (1929).—B. 1891; ag. 4th clk., post office, Bahamas, Apr. and Nov., 1909; cadet, Out islands, Feb., 1910; 3rd elk., C.S.O., and clk. to pub. bd. of wks., New Providence, Sept., 1912; 2nd clk., C.S.O., Feb., 1914; ch. clk., C.S.O., Aug., 1919; enlisted for active serv., 1915, 2nd lieut., Mar., 1919; served in France; twice wounded; discharged from Army, Apr., 1919; resumed duties, May, 1919; ag. clk. in charge, col. sec.'s office, Aug. to Sept., 1923; ag. col. sec. and temp. memb., exec. coun., on various occasions, 1923-34; ag. A.D.C. to admstr., Sept. to Nov., 1925; ast. col. sec., July, 1928.

BETHELL, DONALD LESLIE.—B. 1895; ed. King Edward VI. Sch., Stourbridge; Canadian Exp. Force, 1914-19; ast. treas., Tanganyika Terr., Sept., 1919; ast. ast. treas., Somaliland, Apr., 1925; ag. treas., Somaliland in 1925, 1927 and 1928; treas., Apr., 1929; treas., Gibraltar, 1931.

BETHELL, WILLIS H.—B. 1875; pub. schl. teacher, Bahamas, 1897; customs offr., Mar., 1901; ag. chief clk., audit dept., June, 1912; chief clk., audit dept., Apr., 1913; ag. auditor of pub. accs. for various periods between 1916 and 1923; audr., Dec., 1925; audr., pub. accs., 1st Dec., 1925.

BETTINGTON, DIGBY ROWLAND ALBEMARLE.—Ed. at United Serv. Coll., Westward Ho!; served with Natal Mounted Pol., 1898-1901; with 2nd Kitchener's Fighting Scouts, 1901-1902 (dangerously wounded, ment. in desig., Queen med. and 6 clasps); inspr., mil. pol., Cyprus, 1903; inspr., pol., Sierra Leone, 1906; ag. commn., pol. and sheriff on several occasions; dep. commn. of pol. and dep. supt., prisons, Gold Coast, 1910; base comdt., Togoland Field Force, 1914; "1914-15" Star, War and Victory med.; title changed to dep. inspr.-gen. of pol. and prisons, 1915; inspr.-gen pol. and prisons, Gold Coast, 1917; inspr.-gen pol., Gold Coast on separation of depts. of pol. and prisons, 1920; King's Police med., 1920; ret., 1924; commdt., pol., Bahamas, 1924; resigned, 1926; chief of pol. Bermuda, 1927.

BEVIR, ANTHONY, M.A.—B. 1895; scholar of Eton, 1903, and of Hertford Coll., Oxford, 1914;
M.A., 1923; served with 7th King's Liverpool Regt., July, 1915 to Apr., 1919; twice ment. in despa.; asst. prin., C.O., 9th Feb., 1921; accompanied Mr. Ormby-Gore on his visit to the West African Colonies, Jan.-May, 1926; pvt.-sec. to Mr. Ormby-Gore, Feb., 1926; prin., 1st Apr., 1929; sec., C.O. confce., 1930.

BEWES, GEORGE PRICE HOPF.—B. 1892; ed., Clifton Coll. and Royal Naval Coll., Osborne; asst. dist. commr., Gold Coast, 25th Aug., 1920.

BEYERS, LT.-COL. LEONARD.—B. 1894; perm. staff, Union defence forces, 1914-32; dir., prisons, Union of S. Africa, Sept., 1932.

BHARUCHA, NAVOJI MANEKJI.—B. 1890; B.A., Cantab. cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1914; office asst. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Jan., 1914; attd. Kurunegala Kach., June, 1914; extra office asst. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., in addn. to his own duties, Aug., 1914; ag. pol. mag., Kurunegala, Apr., 1916; office asst., govt. agt., E.Prov., Jan., 1917; pol. mag., Kurunegala, Nov., 1917; Balapitiya, Nov., 1918; dist. judge, Tangalla, Mar., 1922; ag. dist. stff., May, 1925; dist. judge, Kalutara, Jan., 1927; dist. judge, Kalutara, Dec., 1932.

BICKLE, W. H.—B. 1885; apptd. after compet. exam. clk. of the 2nd div., and assigned to C.O., 17th Mar., 1905; cler. offr., higher grade, 1st Apr., 1922; staff offr., 4th Sept., 1929.

BIDEN, CLAUDE ERIC DE BER.—B. 1887; ed., Radley Coll.; asst. audr., S. Nigeria, 1911; on active serv., attd. Nigerian Overseas Contt., German E. Africa, and W. African Serv. Brig., 1917-19; senr. asst. audr., Nigeria, 1926; dep. audr., Gold Coast, 1930; mem., rly. retrenchment comttee, 1931; ag. audr., May, 1932; audr., Palestine and Trans-Jordan, May, 1933.

BIENENMAN, G. A. J., B.A.—B. 1889; ed., Dean Close, Cheltenham and Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge; junr. supt., educn. dept., N. Nigeria, July, 1913; head of training coll., Oct., 1921; ch. inspr., educn., N. Provs., Nigeria, 1929; ag. asst. dir., educn., N. Provs., 1931, 1932, 1933 and 1934; ag. dir., educn., Nigeria, 1934.

BIGELOW, HENRY VERDER, K.C., B.A., LL.B., M.A.—B. 1874; ed., pub. schls., Truro, N.S., and Dalhousie Univ., B.A., 1894; LL.B., 1896; M.A., 1897; admitted to bar of N.S. 1896; practised law at Truro, N.S., and Regina, Sask.; K.C., Sask., 1913; judge, King's Bench, Sask., Feb., 1918.

BIGG, WILFRED JOSEPH.—B. 1897; boy clk., G.P.O., 22nd Nov., 1912; apptd. after compet. exam. clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv. and assigned to C.O., 1st De., 1914; on mil. ser. from 31st Aug., 1914, to 8th May, 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 1922; asst. prin., 1st Aug., 1925; pvt.-sec. to perm. under sec., D.O. (Sir Ed. Harding), 3rd Feb., 1930; prin., 22nd June, 1931.

BIRCH, HUGH MASSEY, M.I.C.E.—Ed. privately and King's Coll., Ldn.; trooper, M.M. Pol., 1897; exec.-engnr., P.W.D., E.A.P., 1907; local capt. E.A. Forces, 1916-18; exec. engnr., P.W.D., Kenya, 1918; B.S.A. Coy.'s, Br. War and Victory med.

BIRCH, W. C.—Asst. analyst, E.A.P., July, 1914; senr. chemical offr., Apr., 1923.

BIRD, EDGAR CLARENCE FREDERICK.—B. 1886; ed., Xaverian Coll.; asst. ch., cust., Zanzibar Prot., Oct., 1914; ag. ch., cust., Jan. to Aug., 1915, May, 1916 to Feb., 1917, and Dec., 1917; marshal, H.R.M. Court for Zanzibar (in Prize), Jan. to Aug., 1915 and from Dec., 1917; immigr. offr., Sept., 1915; dep. comptr., cust., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1920; ag. comptr., cust., on various occasions, 1921-29; dep. comptr., cust., Nigeria, 1930; comptr., Nov., 1931.

BIRD, REGINALD.—B. 1893; ed., Merton Coll., Oxford; B.A. 1919; war serv., 1914-19; cadet, S.S., Oct., 1919; ag. dist. offr., Alor Gajah, June, 1920; asst. dist. judge, S'pore, Aug., 1922; asst. sec. to res., Selangor, July, 1924; dist. offr., K. Pilah, July, 1925; asst. advr., B. Pahat, Aug., 1928; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1929; ag. stamp and prob. offr., S'pore, Aug., 1933; ag. dep. treas., S.S., May, 1934.

BIRKINSHAW, FRANK.—B. 1887; asst. agrl. supt. and sc. mast., gram. schl., St. Vincent, Aug., 1912; agrl. instr., Mauritius, Jan., 1916; inspr., co-op. credit socs. in adln., Oct., 1915; agrl. supt., Sept., 1919; asst. agrl. inspr., Perak, F.M.S., June, 1920; agrl. field offr., Perak North, Dec., 1924; ditto P. Wellesley and Penang in adln., Apr., 1926; sr. agrl. field offr., Perak, Sept., 1931.

BIRKITT, FRANK.—B. 1888; Imp. postal serv. (tels.) 1898-1902, mails, 1903-07; adm'tive. (cler. and acctg.) 1908; staff record offr., 1909; postmr., Nyasaland Prot. (various offices) 1912; (active serv., 1914-15. N.V.R., Nthn. Rhodn. Forces), ag. asst. P.M.G. various occasions; 1st cl. clk., 1920; ch. acct. and sktrp., 1923; P.M.G., Br. Guiana, 1927; temp. M.L.C. in 1932-34.

BIRSE, ARTHUR LOUIS.—B. 1893; cadet, S.S., Apr., 1921; collr., income tax, S'pore, Sept., 1921; treas., exec. cmte., Br. Malaya, Br. Emp. Exhib., in adln., Jan., 1923; recvr., Alsagoff Concession, Kubub, Mar., 1926; offr., cls. III, June, 1930; ag. comntr., land and mines, Trenggauu, Mar., 1932; ag. stamp and prob. offr., S'pore, Sept., 1234.

BIRT, DUDLEY THOMAS.—B. 1881; ed., Uppingham and Univ. of Durham; M.B., M.B.S., Durham, 1905; certif. I.S.T.M.; house surg. and supt., Grey Hosp., Pietermaritzburg, Natal, 1908; mel. offr., Nigeria, West African med. staff, July, 1913; senr. med. offr., Mar. 1927, and transf'd. to Sierra Leone; senr. med. offr., Gambia, July, 1929; mem., exec. and leg. couns.; asst. dir., med. services, Nigeria, 1934.

BIRTWISTLE, WILLIAM.—B. 1890; ed., Queen Elizabeth's Grammar Schl., Blackburn; asst. naturalist (fisheries), min. of agr. and fisheries; directed research in dept. of oceanography, univ., Liverpool; fisheries economist, S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1924; offr.-in-ch., fisheries dept., S.S. and F.M.S., Apr., 1928; attended 5th Pacific Science Congress, Vancouver, B.C., as S.S. and F.'s govt. deleg., June, 1933.

BISCOE, CECIL JULIAN TYNDALE, M.C., B.A., F.R.G.S.—B. 1895; ed., Trin. Coll., Glenalmond, Trent Coll., Derbyshire, and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; war serv., R.A., 1914-18 (France and Palestine); supt., educn., Tanganyika Territory, 1924; ag. dir., educn., May-Nov., 1932.

BISCOE, VINCENT FREDERICK.—B. 1886; ed. at Cheltenham Coll. and Clare Coll., Camb.; B.A., June, 1908; 2nd lieut. London Rifle Brig. (Territorial Force), June, 1909; called to bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1910; asst. res., N. Nigeria, Aug., 1911; 2nd cls. dist. offr., Dec., 1919; ag. station mag., Dec., 1924.

BISHOP, CECIL WILLIAM EDWIN, B.Sc.(Eng.), A.M.Inst.C.F., A.M.Inst.W.E.—B. 1899; ed., Reigate Grammar Schl. and King's Coll., Lond. Univ.; war serv., 1918-19; engr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1922.
BISSET, WILLIAM DAVID, O.B.E. (mil.), A.M.I.Mech.E.—B. 1889; ed. Gordon Schol., Huntly, Aberdeenshire, and Allen Glen's Schol., Glasgow; engrnr. lieut., R.N., Jan., 1914; engrnr. lieut. comdr., R.N., Apr., 1919; engrnr.in-ch., Misida dockyard, Malta, 1916-19; H.M.S. "Egmont," 1920; ast. engrnr., marine dept., Nigeria, 1920; prin. engrnr., 1933; ag. supt. engrnr., 1934.

BITCHENER, HON. JOHN.—B. 1866; entd. N.Z. parl., 1919; jun. whip in reform party, 1927; sen. whip, 1928; jun. whip in coalition party, 1931; min. of pub. wks., 1933.

BLACK, ARCHIBALD MAULE.—Ed. S. BOULDERSON, G. H. C.—Aast. dist. comntr., E. Africa Prot., Mar., 1912; 1st grade admivte. offr., Jan., 1924; prov. comntr., 1934.

BOURNE, JOHN DUNBAR MACDOWALL.—B. 1886; examiner, E. and A. dept., Feb., 1906; ast. auditor, N. Nigeria, Aug., 1909; ast. audr., Br. Guiana, Feb., 1920; audr., Somaliland Prot., July, 1921; audr., B. Guiana, Oct., 1923; senr. ast. audr., Nigeria, July, 1927; audr., Sierra Leone, 1930.

BOVELL, SIR HENRY ALLEYN, KNT. BACH. (1902).—B.1854; Gilchrist scholar (London Univ.), Jan., 1873; LL.B. BOVELL-JONES, LIONEL CLIFFORD.—B. 1897; ed. Christ's Hosp.; enlisted 1915; served in France, Feb., 1916-Aug., 1918; demob., 1919; sub-inspr., pol., British Guiana, July, 1920; dist. inspr., 1924; offr.-in-ch., punitive expedn. to Venezuelan bdy., 1925; passed colloquial Hindi exam., 1927; county inspr., 1931.

BOWEN, F. C. P.—B. 1896; copyist, audit dept., B. Honduras, 1912, also depts. of col. sec. and regis.-gen.; 3rd cls. clk., atty.-gen's off., 1915; 2nd cls. clk., ditto, 1918; clk. to regis.-gen., 1919; secy., riot inquiry comm., 1919; ag. regis.-gen. and cust. enemy pty., and contrl., L.C.O., 1920; secy., yellow fever inquiry comm., 1921; ag. regis.-gen., 1921, 1923 and 1925; regis.-gen., regis., lands titles, supt., vice-adm'y. and bankcy. cts., companies, patents, births, marriages and deaths, 1927; J.P.; stamp commr., dir., pub. offr. guarantee fund; commr., income tax, 1927; sec. in arbitrn. between govts. of U.S.A. and Guatemala, 1930.

BOWER, SIR GRAHAM JOHN, K.C.M.G. (1892), C.M.G. (1886).—B. 1848; ret. commr., R.N.; entered navy, 1861, and served on Mediterranean; E. coast of Africa, E. BOWLER, WALTER, C.B.E., (1931), B.A., St.John's Coll., Camb. (class. tripos, 1899); apptd. clk., col. audit branch of E. and A. Dept., Nov., 1901; ast. audr., S. Nigeria, Nov., 1907, to Mar., 1908; local audr., Gambia, Apr., 1908; local audr., G. Coast, Nov., 1909; title changed to audr., 1910.

BOWMAN, HUMPHREY ERNEST, C.B.E. (1918).—B. 1879; ed. Eton and New Coll., Oxford (2nd cls. mod. hist. 1902); B.A., 1902; M.A., 1906; ent. Egyptian miny. of educn., 1903; seconded to Sudan govt. Command, 1916-18; India, 1918; Mesopotamia, 1918-20; ret. with rank of major, 1920; seconded from M.E.F. as dir. of educn., Mesopotamia, 1918-20; seconded to govt. of Palestine, 1920-23; dir. of educn., Palestine, 1920; mem., advisory coun. since 1920; chmn., comm. on crafts and industries, 1922; mem., transliteration comte., 1923; chmn., comte. on transliteration of geographical names, 1924.

BOWRING, ARCHIBALD GEORGE.—Ed. Nottingham High Schl. and Nottingham Univ. Coll.; capt., Sherwood Foresters, 1914-19; miny. of lab., Nov., 1919 to Nov., 1920; col. audit dept., Nov., 1920; ast. audr., Nigeria, Jan., 1921; do., Sierra Leone, Mar., 1930; ag. audr., May to June, 1930.

BOWRING, SIR CHARLES CALVERT, K.C.M.G. (1925), K.B.E. (1919), C.M.G. (1908).—Ed. at Clifton Coll.; col. audit branch of exchequer and audit dept., 1890; Hong Kong, Dec., 1922; loc. aud., B. C. Africa, Sept., 1895; loc. aud., East Africa Prot. and Uganda rly., June, 1899; treas., E. A. P., Oct., 1901; mem., exec. and leg. couns., E. A. P., 1907; ch. sec. to govt., E. A. P., Apr., 1911; ag. govr., Feb. to Oct., 1912, Aug. to Oct., 1913, Apl., 1917 to Jan., 1919, and from Nov., 1919; gov., Nyasaland, 1923-1924.

BOWRING, HON. SIR EDGAR RENNIE, K.C.M.G. (1934), KT.BACH. (1915).—B. 1855; mem. legis. coun., Newfoundland, 1897; high commr. for Newfoundland in London, 1919.

BOWRING, WALTER ANDREW, C.B.E. (1928).—Ed. at Eton; clk., col. audit branch, 1st Dec., 1894; served in Cyprus, 1896; ast. audr., E.A.P. and Uganda Rly., 13th Feb., 1899; ag. local auditor, Uganda Prot., 1899; ag. local auditor, Somaliland Prot., 1900, and in 1922; local auditor, Uganda Prot., 31st May, 1922; treas., Cyprus, 11th Nov., 1909; mem. exec. and legis. couns., Cyprus, 1909; chief refugee commr., Cyprus, 1915 (during war); passed exam. in Turkish, Feb., 1919; treas., Gibraltar, 1924; admtr., Dominica, July, 1931; mem., fedl. exec. coun., Leeward Is., July, 1931.

BOWYER, ERIC BLACKLOCK.—B. 1902; ed. Whitehill Schl. and Glasgow Univ.; open scholarship, 1920; B.Sc. (with distinction), 1923; G. A. Clarke schol., 1923; M.A. (1st cls. hon. in maths. and nat. philosophy), 1924; ast. inspr., tax., 1925; ast. to C.O. as ast. prin. after compet. exam., 8th Nov., 1926; joint sec., col. survey comte., 1927; seconded for serv. with col. development comte., 1st Oct., 1930; pvt. sec. to partly. under-sec. of State for hom. affrs. (Mr. Lunn), 22nd June, 1931; do. (Mr. Malcolm MacDonald), 3rd Sept., 1931; ag. prin. 6th March, 1935.

BOYCE, E. A., B.Sc. (Edin.).—B. 1898; ast. engrn., P.W.D., Uganda Prot., 1925; ast. engrn. in charge Mbale dist., 1926; ditto, N. Prov., 1927; dep. D.P.W., Bahamas, Aug., 1928; ag. D.P.W. in 1930 and 1932.

BOYD, EDMUND B.—B. 1894; ed. Aberdeen Gram. Schl. and Univ. of Aberdeen; M.A. 1916; 1st cls. hona. classics; on military service, 1916; with 60th siege batt., R.G.A., France and Belgium, Nov., 1917, to June, 1919; 2nd lieut., Oct., 1917; lieut., Apr., 1919; temporary clk. ir. C.O., Sept., 1919; apptd. by civ. ser. commrs. under reconstr. scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., Jan., 1920; ast. prin., 1st Apr., 1920; priv. sec. to

Inst. comtes. of enquiry, 1923; priv. sec. to Lord Arnold, 26th Jan., 1924; ag. prin., 12th Dec., 1924; prin., 2nd Nov., 1925; sec., C.O. confce., 1927; sec., col. development advisory comte., 1929; pvt. sec. to S. of S. for the Cols. Cunliffe-Lister), 9th Nov., 1931.

BOYD, PETER FERGUSON.—B. 1893; telegraphist, Union of S. Africa, Sept., 1906 to Dec., 1911; postal astt., N. BOYD-SHANNON, GODFREY ECCLESTON.—B. 1907; ed. Wellington and Cambridge; schol., St. John's Coll., 1926; 1st cls. class. triplos, pt. I., 1928, pt. II., 1929; Browne med., 1928; B.A., 1929; apptd. after compet. exam., astt. prin., D.O., 27th Oct., 1930.

BOYDELL, HON. THOMAS.—Served apprenticeship as engr. at R. & W. Hawthorns & Leslie, St. Peters, nr. Newcastle-on-Tyne; came to S. African Labour Party in parl.; chmn., party labour caucus; national organiser of party; min. of posts and tels. and pub. wks. in Hertzog cabinet, June, 1924; min. of lab., 1925-29; nominated senator, Sept., 1929.

BOYES, JOHN HENRY.—B. 1886; ed. Prince Albert Coll., Auckland; joined N.Z. pensions dept., 1903; regist., pensions, 1910; astt. comsrs., 1919; comsrs., 1929.

BOYLE, SIR ALEXANDER GEORGE, K.C.M.G. (1921), C.M.G. (1908), C.B.E. (1919).—B. 1872; ed. at Charterhouse, Clifton Coll. and R.I.E.C., Cooper's Hill; priv. sec. to senior puisne judge, S. BOYSE, V. H., O.B.E. (1933), M.B.E. BRACE, IVOR LLANELYN, B.L.—B. 1898; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1921; pol. mag., Gold Coast, 1930; ditto, Nigeria, 1931; crown coun., 1932.

BRADBURN, COL. WILLIAM ERNEST HORATIO.—B. 1884; served, Imp. Yeomanry, 1901; S. BRADLEY, BENJAMIN GERALD.—B. 1899; ed. Eastbourne Coll. and R. Mil. Asylum, 1901; asst. med. offr., Seychelles, Aug., 1901; J.P. and chmn. of loc. bd. of health, 1st and 2nd divs., South Mahé; med. sup't., lunatic asylum, Seychelles, Mar., 1906; ch. med. offr., 1924.

BRADNEY, GEORGE PRESTON.—B. 1877; ed. at Oratory Sch., Edgbaston, and Trinity Hall, Camb.; B.A., Cantab.; hon. in hist., 1899; col. audit offr., June, 1901; asst. aud., B.C. Africa, Feb. 1902; asst. auditor, East Africa Prot., Sept., 1904; auditor, Fiji, and Western Pacific Protectorates, 1909; dir. of external audit, S. Stltmtn. and F.M.S., Oct., 1914; ag. aud.-gen., S. BRADY, Lieut.-Col. JOHN BANKS, D.S.O.—Head mast., Grey Coll. Sch., Dec., 1901; inspr. of schls., O.R.C., Feb., 1904; inspr. of schls., Rhodesia, Aug., 1909; on active serv., 1914-20; commanded 4th and 18th batts. BACH (1924), B.A., B.C.L., Durham Univ.—Called to the bar, Gray's Inn, May, 1892; ag. chief mag., St. Vincent, 1895 to Jan., 1898; asst. to atty.-gen., Leeward Islds., May, 1898; ag. atty.-gen., July to Nov., 1899; mem. legis. coun. and exec. coun., Dominica; mem. general legis. coun., Leeward Is., 1899; atty.-gen., Leeward Is., 2 Sept., 1902; chancellor of the Diocese of Antigua, 1903-1909; pres., Antigua defence reserve force, 1903; ag. col. sec., Oct., 1902; apptd. to combined offices of col. sec. and atty.-gen., Leeward Islds., Jan., 1903; deleg. to agric. confere., Jamaica, 1907; Barbados, 1908; Canadian reciprocity confere., Barbados, 1908; cotton confere., Liverpool, 1908; commr. to prepare a new and revised edition of laws of Leeward Islds., Feb., 1909; admstg. govt. of Antigua on various occasions in the years 1902 to 1909; ag. gov., Leeward Islds., Nov.-Dec., 1907, and Apr. to Oct., 1908; atty.-gen., Jamaica, Oct., 1909; deleg. to Canada on banana tax question, 1915; deleg. to Indent. BURDETT, HENRY LEATHAM, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; war serv., Nov., 1914 to Aug., 1919; asst. engr., Basutoland, 1921; seconded to Tanganyika as road inspr., 1929.

BURGE, G. H. K.—B. 1890; cadet, Gilbert and Ellice Islands, Jan., 1915.

BURGES-S, W. C.—S. African civ. serv.; offr.in-charge, finger print bureau, Kenya, Oct., 1919.

BURKE-GAFFNEY, H.J. O'D., M.D., B.Ch., B.A.O. (Dub.).—B. 1901; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1925; asst. bacteriologist, 1929.

BURNS, A.C., C.M.G. African Regt., 1914-15; adjutant, Nigeria Land Contingent, 1915; served with Egba Expdn., 1918; joint compiler, Index to Laws of Leeward Is., 1910; compiler, Nigeria Handbooks, 1917-23; author of "A History of Nigeria" 1929.

BURNS, R. E., LL.B., London (1908).—2nd clk., regir's off., St. Kitts, June, 1898; ag. clk., town commn., Basseterre, June to Dec., 1899; clk., P.O., Oct., 1901; extra rev. offr., treasy., Dec., 1899; ag. clk., treasy., May, 1902, to Mar., 1903; ag. govt. clk., clk., ex. and legis. couns., clk., bd. of health, Apr., 1903, to Mar., 1904, June, 1904; ag. clk., treasy., St. Kitts-Nevia, July, 1904; tariff clk., treasy., St. K.-N., Oct., 1904; ag. audit clk., Mag., 1905, to Feb., 1906, and Oct., 1906, to May, 1907; 2nd cls. supervisor of cust., G. BURNS, WILLIAM ALOYSIUS, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1900; ed. St. Aloysius Coll. and Vety. Coll., Glasgow; vety. offr., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1923.

BURR, MAJOR FRANCIS WILLIAM MANFRED, A.M.I.C.E., Chtd. Civ. Engrnr.—B. 1884; ed., Bedford Schl. and Crystal Palace Schl. of Eng.;
BURRILL, HON. MARTIN.—B. 1858; ed. St. John's Coll., Hurstpierpoint; fruit farmer in Niagara Peninsula fourteen years; moved to B. Columbia, 1900; apptd. mem. bd. of horticulture, B. Govt., 1907-08; elected to H. of C., Canada, for Yale-Cariboo, 1908; re-elected, 1911 and 1917; mem. of the Privy Council for Canada and min. of agric. in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; sec. of state and min. of mines, Oct., 1917; joint libr. of parlmt., July, 1920.

BURROWES, BERTRAM, LL.B. (Hons.) Univ. Coll., London.—B. 1883; called to bar. Gray's Inn, 1920; treas., Jamaica, 1903; judi. dept., 1915; clk., etc., 1921; judge, grand ct., Cayman Is., 1924; supernm. res. mag., Jamaica, 1925; ag. res. mag., 1925; res. mag., 1926.

Rhodesia, Sept., 1923; high commnr. and commdr.-in-ch., Palestine, and high commnr. for Trans-Jordan, 1928-31.

CHANDLER, MAJOR HERBERT WILLIAM RALPH, M.C.—B. 1894; custom dept., Gold Coast, July, 1920; sr. collr., cust., June, 1928; inspr., cust., Sept., 1933.

CHANDLER, STANLEY FREDERICK.—B. 1898; entd. C.O., Nov., 1913; apptd. after compet. exam., ast. clk., C.O., Apr., 1916; on mil. serv., Sept., 1915 to Mar., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

CHANDLER, SIR WILLIAM KELLMAN, K.C.M.G. (1927), Kt. BACH. (1915), C.M.G. (1902), B.A., LL.D.—B. 1857; St. John's Coll., Camb. (1875-79); law tripes, 1879-80; called to the bar, Inner Tem., June, 1879; ag. escheator-gen. of Barbados, 1880-81; J.P., 1880; apptd. commnr. of probates, Dec., 1880; ag. pol. mag. of Bridgetown, Aug. to Nov., 1880; ag. solr.-gen., Nov., 1880, to Mar., 1881; ag. judge of ast. ct. of appeal, Mar., 1881, to June, 1883; master-in-chancery, May, 1882; judge of ast. ct. of appeal, June, 1883; mem. of house of assem., Mar., 1881; represented parish of St. Peter until Nov., 1884; M.L.C., 1884; represented Barbados in negotiations at Washington in connection with McKinley Tariff Act, 1891; ag. ch. just., Nov., 1901, to Apr., 1902; ag. col. sec., July, 1902, to Feb., 1903, and Apr. to Oct., 1903.

CHANTER, ALFRED BERNARD, M.Inst.T.—B. 1884; asst. traffic suplt. and ag. dist. traffic
supdt., S. Indian rly., 1907-17; dist. traffic supdt., E. African Mily. rly., German E. Africa (Occupied Territory), Aug., 1917-19; ag. traffic man., Tanganyika rly., in 1920, 1921 and 1923; traffic man., June, 1923.

CHAPLIN, Sir Francis Drummond Percy, G.B.E. (1923), K.C.M.G. (1917).—B. 1866; ed. Harrow and Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A.; barrister, Lincoln's Inn, 1891; pres. of chamber of mines, Transvaal, 1905; M.H.A., Transvaal, 1907-10; M.L.A. for Germiston, Union of South Africa; admstr. of Southern Rhodesia, 24th Dec., 1914, and at N. Rhodesia, March, 1921; resigned both appts., Sept., 1923.

CHAPMAN, Hon. Sir Frederick Revans, Kt. Bach. (1923).—B. 1849; judge of sup. ct., New Zealand, 1903-21; pres. of ct. of arbit., 1903-7; compiler of statutes, 1921-25.

CHARLEWOOD, Lieut.-Comdr. Clement James, D.S.C. (1914), R.N.R. (Ret.)—B. 1888; ed. Newcastle Prep. Schl., Newcastle-upon-Tyne, and on board H.M.S. "Worcester" from May, 1903 to July, 1905; midshipman in R.N.R., 4th Aug., 1905; employed by British India Steam Navigation Co., Ltd., July 1909 to Aug., 1914; comd. small craft taking part in blockade and subsequent capture of coast of German E. Africa, being selected by Rear-Adm. E. Charlton to rec. surrdr. of Daressalaam on 4th Sept., 1916; attached to Zanzibar govt. to suprnt. docking and repairs to Zanzibar govt. steamers "Cupid" and "Khalifa," July, 1917 to Apr., 1918; apptd. to H.M.S. "Oroona" for escort duties in Nth. Atlantic, Apr. to Nov., 1918; ast. port offr., Zanzibar, Apr., 1919; port offr., 5th Dec., 1923; lieut. comdr., R.N.R. (ret. list), 10th Apr., 1925; Brilliant Star of Zanzibar, 3rd cls., 1934.

CHARTER, Arthur Ernest, O.B.E. (1922).—B. 1882; Transvaal land sttlm. bd., 1901; land dept., 1902; priv. sec. to commr. of lands, 1903; ag. ch. clk., land and irrigtn. dept., 1908; ch. clk., adminstr.'s off., June, 1910; prov. sec., Natal, Feb., 1928.

CHASE, William Henry, C.B.E. (1934), O.B.E. (1925).—B. 1880; ed. Blundells; graduated London, 1901; F.R.C.V.S., 1907; gov't. vet. surg., Cape Colony, 1902; ch. vet. offr., Bechuanaland Prot., 1905; hon. sub-inspr., Bech. Prot. pol.; J.P., 1920.

CHASEN, Fredric Nutter.—B. 1896; trooper Norfolk Yeomanry (K.O.R.R.), Apr., 1915; 2nd lieut., Suffolk Regt., Mar., 1919; ast. curator, Raffles Museum, S'pore, Jan., 1921; curator, Mar., 1924; dir., Raffles Museum and Library, S'pore, Mar., 1932.

CHAYTOR, C. J.—B. 1889; ed. King's Schl., Worcester; served in Royal Navy, 1906-12 (asst. paymr.); ast. res., N. Nigeria; attld. as lieut., Cameroon Expdy. Force, Aug., 1914 to May, 1916; seconded to Admty., Aug., 1917; served as pavmr. lieut.-commdr., H.M.S. Liverpool, Adriatic, Mediterranean and Black Seas; demob., May, 1919; 1st cls. interpreter, French and higher standard Hausa, 1919; lower standard Arabic, 1924; temp. atttd. to C.O., 1927.

CHAYTOR, Maj.-Gen. Sir Edward Walter Clervaux, K.C.M.G. (1918), K.C.V.O., C.B. (D.), A.D.C. to the King.—B. 1868; jnl. Marlborough Hussar Vol. (N.Z.), 1886; lieut., Oct., 1888; capt., Mar., 1893; maj. in N.Z. Militia, Mar., 1901; lieut.-col., Jan., 1902; temp. col., Jan., 1911; transf. to N.Z. Staff Corps, Jan., 1911; prom. col., June, 1913; maj.-gen., Apr., 1917; comdt.; N.Z. mil. forces, Dec., 1919; ret., Mar., 1924; served in S. African War, 1900-1902 (severely wounded); mentd. in desps.; (Queen's med., three clasps, King's med., two clasps); left N.Z. with main body N.Z. Exped. Force 1914 as A.A.C. with rank of col.; temp. brig.-gen., Dec., 1915; temp. maj.-gen. while employed as a divl. comdr., Apr., 1917, and maj.-gen. in N.Z.E.F., Apr., 1917; apptd. G.O.C., N.Z.E.F. in Egypt; Order of the White Eagle, 3rd cls. (with swords) (Serbian), 1916; Order of the Nile, 2nd cls., 1918; mentd. in desps. (6).

CHEESEMEN, Harold Ambrose Robinson.—B. 1889; ed. Peras Schl.; European instr., Penang Free Schl., Sept., 1907; instruc., Penang normal classes in addn., Aug., 1908; instruc. ditto, Apr., 1909; headmast., Northam rd. scl., Aug., 1922; instruc. schls., Penang, Jan., 1923; supt., educn., Johore, Mar., 1923; instruc., schls., Singapore and Labuan, 1934.

CHELMSFORD, 3rd Baron (U.K.), creat. 1856.

Frederic John Napier Thesiger, G.C.M.G. (1912), K.C.M.G.—B. 1868; ed. at Winchester and Magdalen Coll., Oxford; B.A. (lst cls. law), 1891; M.A., 1894; Fellow of All Souls, 1892; called to the bar, Inner Tem., 1893; mem. of London scl. bd., 1901-4; mem. of L.C.C., 1904; gov. of Queensland, 8th Aug., 1905; gov. of N.S. Wales, 16th Mar., 1909, to Mar., 1913; ag. gov.-gen. of Australia, Dec., 1909 to Jan., 1910; chancellor of the Order of St. M. and St. G., 1914-1916; viceroy of India, 1916; first lord of the admty., Jan.-Nov., 1924.

CHEVERTON, Reginald Leslie, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P. (Lond.)—B. 1901; casualty house surg., 1927; house surg., 1927, and house physician, 1928, gen. hosp., Birmingham; dist. med. off., Cyprus, Dec., 1928; ag. dir., health, Aug., 1933; ag. surg. specialist, June-Sept., 1933; senr. med. offr., Falkland Is., 1934.

CHILCOT, Thomas Charles.—B. 1883; ent. C.A. shipping agts., 1902; apptd. to C.A. office, 1912; ast. head, gen. dept., Mar., 1922; dep. head, pav. dept., Nov., 1933; acctnt., E. African currency bd., 1920.

CHILTON, N., B.A. (Hons.), B.M., B.Ch. (Oxf.), D.T.M. & H. (Lond.).—B. 1910; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1929.

CHIN, Egbert Sydney Algernon, Dip. Ag. (I.C.T.A.).—B. 1908; field offr., genetic dept., cotton research station, Trinidad, 1931; spl. agrl. ast., Montserrat, Mar., 1931.

CHINTAMANI, R.—B. 1878; apptd. cls. I, Ceylon civ. serv., Feb., 1934; office ast., Pettalam kach., Feb., 1934.

CHISHOLM, Sir Joseph Andrew, Kt. Bach. (1935)—B. 1863; ed. at pub. schl., St. Andrews Univ. of St. Francis Xavier, Antigonish (B.A. and M.A.), and Dalhousie Law Schl., Halifax (LL.B.); admitted to the bar, 1886; mayor of Halifax, 1909, 1910 and 1911; pres. of Union of Canadian Municipalities, 1910; K.C., 1917; puisne judge, sup. ct., Nova Scotia, Feb., 1916; ch. just., June, 1931.

CHRISTIAN, John Harold Smith, M.C.—B. 1887; ed. Alderman Newton's schl., Leicester; apptd. after compet. exam., elk., G.P.O., 1914; on mil. serv., 4th Aug., 1914 to 8th June, 1919; ment. in desps., Feb., 1915; commanded cavalry corps signals, 1919; loaned to C.O., 17th Jan., 1921; apptd. cler. offr. and as signed to C.O., 1st Arr., 1921; ag. cler. offr., higher grade, 10th Oct., 1923.

CHRISTIANI, Henry Perot, F.R.G.S.—B. 1878; ed. Cranleigh Schl., 6th cls. cls., cust. Br. Guiana, 1897; 6th cls. elk., treas., 1903; 3rd cls. offr. and govt. survr., lands and mines dept.,

1904; 2nd cls. offr. and govt. surv., 1908; drawing office supt., 1924; sec., lands and mines dept., 1927; sec. and acctnt., dept. of lands and mines, 1929; ag. commnr., lands and mines, 1933.

CHRISTIE, JAMES, C.M.G. (1934), LL.M. (N.Z.).—B. 1880; ed. State schl. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; schl. teacher, 1897; N.Z. treas. dept., 1901; crown law office, 1904; law drafting office, 1907; astt. law draftsman, 1912; ag. law draftsman, 1916; law draftsman, 1918.

CHRISTISON, FRED HAMILTON, M.B.E. (mily.) (1918).—Astt. treas., G. Coast, 1901-03; temp. comsn., army pay dept., 1915; K.A.R. pay dept., July, 1916; ag. ch. paymr., K.A.R., 1917; ment. in desps., 1917; astt. treas., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1919; senr. astt. treas., May, 1930; ag. dep. treas., Oct., 1932-Apr., 1933.

CHRISTOFFELSZ, ARTHUR ERIC.—B. 1890; B.A., LL.B., Cantab.; barrister-at-law; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. serv., Mar., 1915; attached to Colombo Kachcheri, Mar., 1915; addtl. pol. mag., Colombo, in addition to his own duties, July, 1915; attached to Kegalle Kachcheri, Apr., 1916; addtl. comnr. of requests and pol. mag., Kegalle, in addn. to own duties, Apr., 1916; ag. extra office astt. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Oct., 1916; ag. pol. mag., Jaffna, 1917; office astt. to govt. agt., Uva, Mar., 1919; pol. mag., Dambagamuwa, Oct., 1920; ditto, Kurune, gala, Sept., 1921; astt. attlt. offr., Oct., 1926; ag. pol. mag., Panadura, Oct. to Nov., 1926; ag. dist. judge, Matara, Mar., 1927; astt. attlt. offr., Dec., 1927; astt. govt. agt., Kegalle, June, 1931; do., Puttalam, Sept., 1933.

CHRISTOFFELSZ, BARIL MORRIS.—B. 1886; cls. V, Ceylon civ. serv., Feb., 1931; office astt., Kalutara kach., Feb., 1931; do., Matara kach., Jan., 1934.

CHURMS, W. H.—B. 1890; apptd., after exam.; astt. library attendant, C.O., 6th Apr., 1911; on military service from 5th Aug., 1914, to 19th Jan., 1919; paper room clk. in library, 1919; cler. offr., 1st Apr., 1921.

CILLIERS, CHARL. ANDRIES, B.A.—B. 1893; ed. Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch (now Univ. of Stellenbosch); clk., defence dept., Union of S.A., 1913; prte. sec. to min. of lands, 1916; ditto, to min. of defence, 1917; ditto, to min. of agr., 1921; under-sec. for pub. wks., 1934.

CLARENCE, EARL OF (cr. 1776) Rt. Hon. GEORGE HERBERT HYDE VILLIERS, P.C. (1931), G.C.M.G. (1930), J.P., D.L.—B. 1877; ed. Eton; prev., lord-in-waiting to H.M.; hon. lieut.-col. (Hertford Reg.) A.D.C. to Lord Lieut. of Ireland (Lord Dudley); chanc., Primrose League, 1919-21; capt., Gentlemen-at-Arms, 1922-23 and 1924-25; dep. speaker, House of Lords; parly. under-sec. of state for dominion affrs., and chmn., overseas settlement cte., 9th July, 1925; chmn. B.B.C., 1927; gov. gen., Union of S. Africa, 1931.

CLARK, ADRIAN JOHN, LL.B. (London.), O.B.E. (Mily.)—B. 1889; King's schol. and Good-enough medallist (Fr. and German), Westminster; called to bar, Inner Temple, 1910; junr. coun. to treasy., 1917; served in Great War, France, Mar., 1915 to May, 1919; capt., 23rd London Regt.; D.A.A.G., Third Army and Lieut.-Col., R.A.F., (S.O., 1st grade); brevet-major and twice ment. in desps.; mag., Victoria, Trinid., July, 1924; ag. puisne judge, Sept. to Dec., 1924; P.O.S., Trinidad, Jan., 1927; puisne judge, Jamaica, May, 1927; ag. ch. just. July-Nov., 1932; dep. pub. pros., Singapore, Sept., 1934.

CLARK, JOHN BUCHANAN.—B. 1897; ed., George Watson's Coll., Edinburgh; S.A. Coll. Schls. and S.A. Coll. (now Univ. of Cape Town); Balliol Coll., Oxford; M.A. (Cape Town), B.A. (Hons.), Oxon.; Rhodes scholar, 1917; 2nd lt. and lt., R.A.S.C., France, Aug., 1917 to Feb., 1919; lect. in hist., Univ. of Cape Town, 1921; lect. classics and hist., Univ. of Witwatersrand, 1924; inspr., schla., June, 1925; ag. dir., European educn., June, 1926-June, 1927; dir., European educn., N. Rhodesia, June, 1927; mem., European educn., comnr., N. Rhodesia, 1929; temp. M.L.C. in 1930 and 1931.

CLARK, J. McK., Ch.B. (Aberdeen), D.T.M. (Liverpool), Certif., Liverpool Schl. of Trop. Med.—Apptd. to W.A.M.S., Sierra Leone, 1914; served in Cameroons Expedy. Force, 1915-16; temp. lieut. (gen. list), 1915-16; temp. med. offr., E. Africa, 1916; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 19th Apr., 1918; senr. med. offr., Apr., 1924.

CLARK, WILLIAM CLIFFORD, M.A.—B. 1889; ed. Williamstown High Schl., Queen's Univ. (Kingston) and Harvard Univ. (Ricardo prize scholarship, Harvard Univ., 1915); Henry Lee memorial fellow and tutor, divn. of hist., govt. and economics, Harvard Univ., 1914-15; successively lecturer, astt. prof., assoc. prof. and prof., economics, Queen's Univ., 1915-23; advr., dept.
of lab., Ottawa, 1918-19; prof., commerce, etc., Queen's Univ., 1931-32; finan. advr., Imp. Economic Conf., Ottawa, 1932; dep. min., finance and sec., treas., bd., Ottawa, Nov., 1932; offl. advr., World Monetary and Economic Conf., 1933; author of various papers in economics and finance and collaborator in Warshow's "Representative American Industries."

CLARK, Sir William Henry, K.C.S.I. (1915), K.C.M.G. (1930), C.S.I. (1911), C.M.G. (1903).—B. 1876; Ed. Trinity Coll., Cambridge; clk. Bd. of T., 1899; sec. to sp. mission to Shanghai to negotiate comm. treaty with China, 1901; ag. 2nd sec., diplomatic serv., 1902; sec. to royal comm. on supply of food, etc., in time of war, 1903-5; pvt. sec. at Bd. of T. to Rt. Hon. D. Lloyd George, 1906, and to Rt. Hon. W. S. Churchill, 1908; and to Rt. Hon. D. Lloyd George as chancellor of the exchequer, 1908-10; mem. for commerce and industry of the comm. of the Viceroy of India, 1910-16; compt.r.-gen., comm. intell. dept. Bd., of T., 1916; compt.r.-gen. dept. of overseas trade, Sept., 1917; high commnr. for Great Britain in Canada, Sept., 1924; high commnr. for Basutoland, the Bechuanaland Prot., and Swaziland and high commnr. in the Union of S. Africa for H.M.'s govt. in the U.K., Jan., 1935.

CLARKE, Arthur Grenfell, B.A.—B. 1906; ed. Mountjoy Sch., Dublin and Trinity Coll., Dublin; cadet, Hong Kong civ. serv., Dec., 1929; passed cadet, Jan., 1932; asst. to sec., Chinese affrs., Feb., 1932.

CLARKE, F. H.—Aast. game warden, E.A.P., 1919; ag. game warden, Kenya, 1932.

CLARKE, Hon. Sir Francis Grenville, K.B.E., M.L.C.—B. 1879; ed. Scotch Coll., Melbourne, Melbourne Univ. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; M.L.O. for N. Prov. (Vic.); min. for lands and water supply, Nov., 1917 to Oct., 1919; min. of pub. wka. and water supply, Oct., 1919 to July, 1923; pres., leg. comm., Victoria, July, 1923.

CLARKE, Hon. Sir Frederick James, K.C.M.G. (1911), C.M.G. (1907).—Ed. Christ Church Mid. Sch., Barbados, and Caius Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1879; M.H.A., Barbados, 1887; pres., Barbados agric. soc., 1905; mem., cent. poor law board; M.E.C., 1905; J.P.; O.C., Barbados vol. force, 1906; speaker, H. of A., Barbados, 1898-1934.

CLARKE, Francis Priestley Courtney.—B. 1879; ed. Haileybury and Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A., Oxford, 1901; LL.B., Cape, 1909; advoc., sup. ct., Cape, 1910; ent. Cape civ. ser., 1903; served in depts. of justice, native affrs. and forests; ch. clk., N.W.A., adminstr., 1923; asst. sec., 1925; sec. for S.W.A., 1934; chmn., S.W.A.—Angola bndry., and Cunene Water comm., 1929; rep. Union govt. at Geneva at mts. of Mandates Comm., 1930.

CLARKE, Geoffrey T. S.—B. 1879; clk. to P.M.O., Basutoland, 1913; clk., treas., 1914; clk. to asst. commnr., 1919; sub.-inspr., Basutoland Mounted Police, 1921; war serv., 1916-19.

CLARKE, Joseph Sherwood, B.A. (Harvard).—B. 1903; ed. Rossall Sch. and Harvard Univ.; supt., educ., Nigeria, Apr., 1927; headmnr., Grammar Sch., St. Vincent, 1931.

CLARKE, Robert William, F.I.C., diploma, food and drugs, agric. chem., biol. chem., and bacteriology.—Analyst to sany. commrs., Gibraltar, Oct., 1913 to Jan., 1921; govt. analyst, Cyprus, Jan., 1921.

CLARKE, Stephen Grainger.—B. 1894; 5th cls. clk., P.W.D., Fiji, 1914; 4th cls. clk., audit dept., 1915; on active ser., 1915; 3rd cls. clk., audit dept., 1922; 2nd cls. clk., 1922; acct., Gilbert and Elliott Ls., 1924; dep. p. commr. (temp. and provin.), 1926; treas., collr., cust. and postmr., 1928; dep. commr., 1929.

CLARKE, Thomas Lisle Evelyn, M.D., C.M., McGill (1911).—B. 1885; ed. at the Lodge Sch., and Harrison Coll., Barbados, and McGill Univ., Montreal; junr. res. surgeon, gen. hosp., Barbados, Aug., 1911; med. offr., Virgin Is., May, 1912; ag. commr. and mag., May, 1915; mem. of quarantine bd., health offr., mem. of exec. coun., and J.P., Virgin Is., July, 1912; ag. commr., Virgin Is., Apr., 1913 to Jan., 1914; ag. commr., mag. and dep. judge, summary jurisdic. ct., Virgin Is., from Dec., 1914 to May, 1917; and from July, 1917 to Oct., 1918; med. offr., St. Kitts-Nevis, Nov., 1918; provisional med. fed. leg. and exec. coun., Leeward Islands, Mar., 1915; J.P., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1918.

CLARKE, W. W.—B.1895; ed. Christian Brothers' Coll., S. Africa; war serv., Rebutance and German S.W. campaign, 1914-15; S. Africa Overseas Contg., 1916-18; temp. heut., 1918; supt., cust., Tanganyika Territory, 1919; ag. supt., cust., Feb., May, 1930.

CLARKSON, Charles Francis.—B. 1881; ed. Boys' Model Sch. and Boys' High Sch., Durban; admitted atty., Natal prov. divn., Feb., 1926; offr., Durban Light Infy., and adjt.; mem., prov. coun., 1915; mem., exec. coun., 1925; senator, 1930; min., posts and tele. and pub. wks., Mar., 1933.

CLARKSON, Frank Cecil, O.B.E. (1885), M.B.E. (1930)—B. 1882; P.W.D., Sudan Govt., 1905-07; ch. asst., S. Nigeria surv., 1911-12; European War, Gallipoli, Egypt and Palestine, 1914-19; asst. supt., pub. wks., and cotton insp., Nevis, Jan., 1921; ag. commr., mag., etc., Virgin Is., Apr., 1922; col. engr. and surv.-gen., Dominica, Jan., 1923; mem., leg. coun., commr., mag., etc., Virgin Is., Nov., 1926; commr. as judge, Turks and Caicos Is., Aug., 1934.

CLAUSON, Gerard Leslie Makine, C.M.G. (1933), O.B.E. (Mily.), 1919.—B. 1891; sec. of Eton, 1903, and C.C.C., Oxford, 1910; Bodleian Sanskrit Scholar, 1911; 1st cls. Class. Hos. Mods., 1912; Hall-Houghton Syriac prizeman, 1913; 2nd cls. Economic Conf., Ottawa, July to Aug., 1932; ag. asst. sec., Int. Dec., 1934.

CLEARE, LAURENCE DELANEY, F.R.E.S., F.L.S.—B. 1896; ed. Cornell Univ.; agrl. instr., Br. Guiana, 1919; econ. biologist, dept. sci. and agr., 1922; rep. col. at 2nd Impl. Entom. CLIFFE, CEDRIC ARTHUR LEWIS, M.A.—B. 1902; schol. of Eton, 1915 and of Balliol Coll., Oxford, 1921; Craven schol., 1922; 1st cls. hons., mods., 1923; Ireland school., 1923; 1st cls. lit. hum., 1925; appld. to C.O. after compet. exam., 20th Oct., 1925; sec., managing comte., Imp. CLIFFORD, SIR HUGH CHARLES, G.C.M.G. (1921), G.B.E., (1925), K.C.M.G. (1909); C.M.G. (1900).—B. 1806; joined Perak service, 1883; passed in Malay, Feb., 1886; coll. land rev., Kuala Kangsar, Mar., 1885; on special service to Pahang, 1887 (reed. thanks of S. of S.); ag. gov't. agt. there, 1887-8; suppt., Ulu Pahang, 1889; ag. Guiana in Nov., 1905, to enquire into municipal institutions; admstd. govt., Mar. to Aug., 1904, and from Apr. to Oct., 1906; col. sec., Ceylon, May, 1907; admstd. govt., on various occasions, 1907-12; gov., G. Coast, Dec., 1912; gov., Nigeria, July, 1919; gov. of Ceylon, Nov., 1925; gov. S. Stltnts. and high comsnr., Malay States, June, 1927; ret., 1929; concluded with M. Noufliard, the lieut.-gov. of Dahomey, in Aug., 1914 an agreement for the temporary partition between the British and French Govts., and for the provisional administration of Togoland; admstd. Br. sphere of occupation, Togoland, concurrently with the G. Coast, from Aug., 1914, to Aug., 1919; chmn., comte., on W. African trade and taxation, Oct.-Nov., 1921 (received thanks of S. of S.); is part author, with Sir Frank Swettenham, of a Malayan dictionary, and author of more than a dozen books, mostly on Malayan subjects, and of a translation of the penal code into Malay; also of a history of the G. Coast regt. in the E. African campaign.

CLINKARD, GEORGE WILLIAM, M. Com. (N.Z.).—B. 1893; ed. Auckland Grammar Schl. and Victoria Univ. Coll.; N.Z. govt. serv., 1909-

CLIPSHAM, PHILIP RICHARD.—B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 31st Sept., 1920; seconded as regar. on staff of high commnr. in Canada for H.M.'s govt. in Gt. Britian, 1932.

CLIVE, CAPT. J. H.—Asst. dist. commnr., Kenya, May., 1920.

CLOHETE, MONTEBOSE CLAVERHOUSE.—B. 1880; master's office, Cape, 1899; Pretoria, 1902; asst. regtr. high ct., Jo'burg, 1903; asst. regtr., Cape prov. divn., 1921; regtr., appellate divn., 1923.

CLOSE, R. W., B.A., LL.B., K.C.—B. 1867; ed. S. African Coll., Cape Town; M.P. for Rondebosch, 1920-29; Mowbray, 1929-33; leader, Cape bar; min. plenip., Washington, Jan., 1934.

CLUBB, HON. WILLIAM RID—B. 1884; served on Morris munici. coun., 1916-20; mem., leg. assembly for Morris, Manitoba, 1920-22; re-elec., July, 1922; min. of public works, Manitoba, 8th Aug., 1922; re-elec. for Morris by accl., 26th Aug., 1922.

CLUVER, EUSTACE HENRY, M.A., M.D., B.Ch., D.P.H.—B. 1894; ed. at Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, S. Africa, Hertford Coll., Oxford and King's Coll. CRAGIE-HALKETT, MONTAGU C., O.B.E. (1934)—Ag. priv. sec. to gov. CRANSTON, T. D.—M.A. (Glasgow); asst. mast., training instn., for teachers, Accra, G. CRAZY, WILLIAM RAYMOND DUNSTAS, B.Sc. (Eng.), A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1900; ed. Gresham's Sch., Holt and London Univ.; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., Zanzibar, Apr., 1926; ag. dist. engrnr., in 1930, 1931, 1933 and 1934; asst. engrnr., P.W.D., Nigeria, 1936.

CRAN, B. A.—Barrister-at-law; dep. recvr. of titles, Kenya, Oct., 1920; res. mag., Apr., 1921; puisne judge, sup. ct., Cyprus, Apr., 1930; ag. puisne, dist. ct., June to Sept., 1930; ag. ch. just.; ch. just., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1934.

CREASY, GERALD HALLEN.—B. 1897; ed. Rugby; schol., King's Coll., Camb., 1915; 2nd lieut., R.G.A., Nov., 1916; lieut., May, 1918; capt. and adjutant, Nov., 1918; app'td. under reconstruction scheme asst. prin., C.O., 26th July, 1920; pvt. sec. to parl. under sec. for dom. affrs., 6th Aug., 1925; dep. sec., C.O. coll., 1927; prin. CREED, HENRY.—B. 1871; app'td., after exam., 3rd class messenger in C.O., July, 1900; 2nd class, 1st Feb., 1904; King's mess., Feb. Jan., 1911; office keeper, 1924; med., Order of Br. Empire, 1931.

CREMER, ARTHUR STANLEY.—B. 1886; ed. Durham schl.; col. audit dept., 23rd Jan., 1911; asst. audr., G. CREMER, JOHN AWDRY.—B. 1881; B.A. (Oxon.), 1903; clk., col. audit branch, R. and A.D., 1903; asst. auditor, Lagos, 1903; asst. auditor, Nyasaland, 1908; 2nd cls. cik., cent. office, 1913; auditor, Nyasaland, 1914; audr., Cyprus, Aug., 1925.

Guiana pol., 1912; ag. dist. inspr., 1914-15; 2nd lieut., Br. Guiana Militia Inf., 1914; served in B.W.I. Regt. as capt., E. Africa and Palestine, 1915-19; dist. inspr., Br. Guiana pol., 1920; J.P. and coroner, 1920; ag. county inspr., 1920; pas'ed final law exam., 1921; cik., Br. Guiana local forces, 1922; ag. staff offr., Br. CREWE, 1ST MARQUESS OF (cr. 1911); ROBERT OFFLEY ASHBURTON CREWE-MILNES, K.G., P.C., M.A., F.S.A.—B. 1858; Baron Houghton of Great Houghton in the county of York, 1863; Earl of Crewe (cr. 1895); Earl of Madeley (cr. 1911); ed. at Harrow and Trin. CRICHLLOW, NATHANIEL.—M.B., Ch.B.; med. offr., Solomon Islands, Oct., 1914; ag. senr. med. offr. on several occasions; travelling med. offr., July, 1927.

CRITIEN, ATTILIO, O.B.E. (1927), M.B.E. (1919), M.A., M.D., Malta Univ., D.P.H., D.T.M. (Liverpool), 1906—R. 1873; demonstr., schl. of anatomy, 1899 to 1901; civil surgeon attchd. CROCKER, WILLIAM HENRY.—B. 1890; served in R.A.S.C. (M.T.) in Mesopotamia, Persia and India; astt. govt. printer, Gold Coast, 1921; ag. govt. printer, 1925, 1927, 1928, 1930 and 1932; supt., govt. press, 1928.

CROCKETT, HON. OSWALD SMITH, LL.D.—B. 1868; ed. pub. and high schls., Fredericton, N.B., Canada, and Univ. of New Brunswick; B.A., 1886; attty., sup. ct., N.B., 1891; called to bar, 1892; M.P. CROOK, WALTER VERNON.—B. 1900; ed. Marlborough Coll., and R. Mily. Coll., Sandhurst; command, Reg. Army, East Surrey Regt., Dec., 1918; served N. Russia, 1919; seconded under C.O., Mar., 1926; cadet, Uganda, 1926; astt. dist. offr., Uganda, June, 1928, and placed on Reg. Army, R. of O.

EVANS, H. G.—Astt. dist. comanr., E.A.P., Apr., 1913; 1st grade admstve. offr., 1925.

EVANS, HON. SIR JOHN WM., KT. BACH. (1926), C.M.G. EVANS, LEONARD WINNIE, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., B.Sc., certif. L.S.T.M. (with distinc.).—B. 1891; med. offr., gen. hosp., S'pore, Jan., 1922; med. and health offr., P.W., north and central, June, 1923; ch. med. offr., Kelantan, Jan., 1929.

EVANS, SAMUEL, Hon. LL.D., Witwatersrand Univ.—B. 1859; pvt. sec. to finan. adviser, Egyptian govt., 1883; ch. contr., Egyptian coast guard serv., 1886; inspr.-gen., Imp. EVELYN, EDWARD A. (jr.)—B. 1904; ed. St. Kitts Grammar Schl.; supernymy.rev.offr., 1922; ch. clk., post office, 1927; dep. habmr. and cashier, treas., 1928; govt. offr., Eastern Dist., Dominica, 1930; ag. mag. dist. F, also addnl. mag., dist. E, 1933; J.P., 1934.
EVELYN, MERRIT.—2nd clk. to pres., St. Kitts, Dec., 1878; ch. clk., treas., Nevis, 1881; ag. treas., Nevis, July, 1882-1883; rev. offr. in charge, Nevis treas., 1883; prot. of imgrts., Nevis, 1883; land and house tax commnr., 1892; ag. mag., Nevis, 1894-5, 1895-6 and 1912; water commnr., Nevis, 1901; chmn., quarantine bd., Nevis, 1911.

EWART, F. K.—B. 1902; ed. Botelor Schl., Warrington and Rossall Schl., Williams Mem. Exh.; schol., Exeter Coll., Oxford, 1920; pres., O.U.S.C., 1923; B.A., 1923 (mem. pt. 1); F.C.S., 1923; 2nd chem., pt. 2, 1924; mem., Inner Temple, 1925; asst. mast., King's Coll., Hongkong, 1926; M.A., 1927.

BYBERS, GEORG VON WELFING.—B. 1887; ed. Boy's High Schl., Beaufort West, Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, Univ. of Amsterdam and King's Coll., London; B.A. (Cape); M.A., D. Litt. EZCHIEL, PERCY HUBERT, C.M.G. (1923).—B. 1876; B.A. Bombay, 1889 (ct. 14); B.A., London, 1894; major schrl., Trin.
